78	@work_node(
79	    name="回测",
80	    group="08-回测",
81	    box_color="red",
82	    description="基于信号与价格面板执行向量化回测，输出净值/回撤曲线与完整绩效指标（年化收益/波动/夏普/索提诺/卡玛/最大回撤/VaR/胜率/盈亏比/月度收益）",
83	    example="因子构建（信号） + QMT行情数据（价格） → 回测 → 输出",
84	    notes=[
85	        "signals / prices 均需连线提供（面板：index=日期, columns=股票）；benchmark 为可选基准收盘序列",
86	        "volume/high/low 为可选连线：提供后启用停牌冻结与一字板不可成交处理，未提供时不处理并在 assumptions 中明示",
87	        "normalize 固定为 long_only：只做普通股票多头，正信号按日归一为满仓组合（Σw≤1），负信号视为不买入；不融资、不融券、不做空",
88	        "佣金率默认 0.001，滑点 0.001，卖出印花税 0.0005（与回测引擎/其余入口口径一致）；T 日信号 T+1 执行；指标按 252 交易日年化",
89	        "止盈/止损/移动止损（0 关闭）：单仓逐仓风控，基于 T-1 收盘判定、T 日执行，避免当日盘中前视；命中会覆盖信号目标为平仓",
90	        "移动止损 trailing_stop 仅对盈利仓生效：自建仓后最高点回撤达比例即止（锁盈）",
91	        "提供 benchmark 时额外输出跟踪误差/信息比率等相对基准指标",
92	    ],
93	)
94	class BacktestNode(BaseWorkNode):
95	    @classmethod
96	    def input_model(cls):
97	        return BacktestInputUI
98	
99	    @classmethod
100	    def output_model(cls):
101	        return BacktestOutput
102	
103	    def run(self, input: BacktestInputUI) -> BacktestOutput:
104	        signals = pd.DataFrame(input.signals)
105	        prices = pd.DataFrame(input.prices)
106	        if signals.empty or prices.empty:
107	            raise ValueError("回测：需要连线提供 signals（信号）与 prices（价格）面板")
108	
109	        volume = pd.DataFrame(input.volume) if input.volume else None
110	        high = pd.DataFrame(input.high) if input.high else None
111	        low = pd.DataFrame(input.low) if input.low else None
112	
113	        for df in (signals, prices, volume, high, low):
114	            if df is None:
115	                continue
116	            try:
117	                df.index = pd.to_datetime(df.index)
118	            except Exception:
119	                pass
120	
121	        # 参考面板：停牌掩码（需 volume）与涨跌停近似价（需参考数据快照）
122	        from backend.services import market_data
123	
124	        reference = market_data.load_reference_panels(close=prices, volume=volume)
125	
126	        result = backtest_analysis.run_backtest(
127	            signals=signals,
128	            prices=prices,
129	            initial_capital=input.initial_capital,
130	            commission_rate=input.commission_rate,
131	            slippage=input.slippage,
132	            stamp_tax=input.stamp_tax,
133	            normalize=input.normalize,
134	            tradable_mask=reference["tradable_mask"],
135	            up_limit=reference["up_limit"],
136	            down_limit=reference["down_limit"],
137	            high=high,
138	            low=low,
139	            take_profit=input.take_profit,
140	            stop_loss=input.stop_loss,
141	            trailing_stop=input.trailing_stop,
142	        )
143	        assumptions = result["assumptions"]
144	        equity_curve = result["equity_curve"]
145	        strategy_returns = pd.Series(result["strategy_returns"])
146	        positions = result["positions"]
147	
148	        # 基准收益（可选）：benchmark 为收盘序列则转收益率，否则当作收益率
149	        benchmark_returns = None
150	        benchmark_curve: dict = {}
151	        if input.benchmark:
152	            bm = pd.Series(input.benchmark)
153	            try:
154	                bm.index = pd.to_datetime(bm.index)
155	            except Exception:
156	                pass
157	            bm = bm.sort_index().astype(float)
158	            # 启发式：值普遍 > 1 视为价格，转收益率；否则视为收益率
159	            benchmark_returns = (
160	                bm.pct_change().fillna(0.0) if bm.abs().mean() > 1 else bm
161	            )
162	            bm_nav = (1 + benchmark_returns).cumprod()
163	            benchmark_curve = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in bm_nav.items()}
164	
165	        # 完整绩效指标 + 回撤曲线（复用 backtest_analysis 服务）
166	        metrics = backtest_analysis.performance_tear_sheet(
167	            strategy_returns, benchmark_returns=benchmark_returns
168	        )
169	        monthly_returns = metrics.pop("monthly_returns", {})
170	        dd = backtest_analysis.drawdown_analysis(strategy_returns.dropna())
171	        drawdown_curve = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in dd["drawdown_series"].items()}
172	
173	        equity_map = {str(k): float(v) for k, v in equity_curve.items()}
174	        # 净值归一（起点=1）供图表与基准同尺度对比
175	        init_cap = float(result["initial_capital"]) or 1.0
176	        nav_map = {k: v / init_cap for k, v in equity_map.items()}
177	
178	        # 回测综合报告（与因子分析综合报告同构，供工作流内弹窗展示）
179	        report = {
180	            "summary": metrics,
181	            "nav_curve": nav_map,
182	            "benchmark_curve": benchmark_curve,
183	            "drawdown_curve": drawdown_curve,
184	            "monthly_returns": monthly_returns,
185	            "top_drawdowns": dd.get("top_drawdowns", []),
186	            "benchmark": metrics.get("benchmark"),
187	            "assumptions": assumptions,
188	            "delisting_events": result.get("delisting_events", []),
189	            "initial_capital": init_cap,
190	            "trading_days": metrics.get("trading_days", 0),
191	        }
192	
193	        return BacktestOutput(
194	            equity_curve=equity_map,
195	            strategy_returns={str(k): float(v) for k, v in strategy_returns.items()},
196	            drawdown_curve=drawdown_curve,
197	            positions={
198	                str(k): {c: float(v) for c, v in row.items()}
199	                if hasattr(row, "items")
200	                else float(row)
201	                for k, row in positions.items()
202	            },
203	            metrics=metrics,
204	            monthly_returns=monthly_returns,
205	            benchmark_curve=benchmark_curve,
206	            assumptions=assumptions,
207	            delisting_events=result.get("delisting_events", []),
208	            report=report,
209	            initial_capital=result["initial_capital"],
210	        )

33:- **回测节点**：向量化回测，默认成本佣金率 0.001 / 滑点 0.001 / 卖出印花税 0.0005（与回测接口、QUBE 一致），T 日信号 T+1 执行，输出净值/回撤曲线与完整绩效（年化收益/波动/夏普/索提诺/卡玛/最大回撤/VaR/CVaR/胜率/盈亏比/月度收益），支持可选基准对比（跟踪误差/信息比率）。**投资边界固定为普通多头**：正信号按日归一为满仓组合，总仓位 ≤ 100%；负信号视为不买入；不融资、不融券、不做空。逐仓风控（止盈/止损/移动止损）仅作用于多头持仓；一字板导致调仓无法成交时不推演挂单（持仓保持，次数在 assumptions 明示）。成本明细拆分输出（佣金/滑点/印花税分列）。

| **工作流编辑器** | iframe 内嵌官方 ComfyUI 前端，搭建研究管线；节点右键查看/编辑代码（Monaco + AI 改写 + ruff 诊断）、因子分析节点「显示分析结果」直接弹出综合报告、内置节点代码 fork 保护、底部本机性能监控；**节点完整输出落本地 pkl、运行记录只存预览**（`/api/workflow/runs/{run_id}/nodes/{node_uuid}/output` 按需取明细）；运行产物长期保留；如需清理，显式调用 `POST /api/workflow/runs/cleanup`（默认 dry_run=true 只统计，传 dry_run=false 才实际删除） |
| **数据探索** | 数据概览、SQL 查询（含 AI 生成 SQL、结果解读、**SQL 历史/收藏与字段字典/查询模板**）、全市场扫描、横截面分析、异常检测，全部基于本地 Parquet 缓存；**市场环境仪表盘**（宽基牛/震荡/熊判定 + 小盘/成长/中盘 vs 大盘风格轮动，数据中心顶部）；**事件研究**（一字涨/跌停、放量、除权除息、手工事件 → 窗口 CAR/BHAR + t 值 + 正值占比；支持指定基准指数与市场模型 alpha/beta，附加按事件日聚类的稳健 t 值，并提供 **calendar-time portfolio** 月度时间序列检验；近邻事件自动合并防重复计数） |
| **因子研究** | 因子库卡片/列表双视图、IC 排序与筛选、点击查看公式（LaTeX + Python 代码）与全部指标、逐因子 AI 分析；IC 汇总/分层平均收益/单调性输出；内置量化算子库，公式可直接在公式节点运行；**因子批量扫描**（勾选类别/因子 → SSE 逐因子进度 → 按 IC/RankIC/ICIR 排序 → 入池；结果覆盖更新+历史快照，并标记**指标来源**：外部参考值 / 本地 QMT 重算值；支持股票池分批扫描、内存保护、样本置信度警示与**多重检验提示**）；**因子体检**（基于 IC 历史快照的生命周期阶段：萌芽/稳定/观察/衰减/失效 + IC 趋势徽标）；**因子池拥挤度**（池内因子两两截面相关）；**样本外验证**（walk-forward 滚动锚定分割，每折 in-sample/OOS IC + 分层多空统计量，防过拟合；多空仅为研究诊断，不代表可交易做空）；**因子池→组合回测闭环**（选因子 → 等权/滚动 IC 加权合成[样本外权重，无前视] → 每日 Top-N 做多 → 回测 → 绩效 → 风格+行业归因一键打通）；**组合 walk-forward 回测**（训练窗口定权重 → 测试窗口出信号 → 滚动拼接样本外净值，附全样本参考对比过拟合差距）；另备 **AlphaLens 分析**（行业分组 IC/分层收益/因子加权多空统计量/换手率）与自研综合报告互补；**因子面板导出 CSV**（`/api/factor/export-panel`，研究交付与离线复核） |
| **分钟因子 · 日内高频** | 分钟缓存（1m/5m/15m/30m/60m）→ 自动清洗（竞价 bar 剔除、半日市/一字板标记）→ 分钟公式求值（`m_*` 字段 + `ID_*` 聚合 / `M_*` 序列算子 + 现成高频因子 TAIL_RET/OPEN_RET/RV/JUMP_DAY/AMIHUD5/VWAP_DEV/VOLUME_CLOCK/AUC_VOL_RATIO/LIMIT_UP_TIME/OVERNIGHT_RET/INTRADAY_RET）→ 自动折叠日频面板，下游全链路复用；**时刻 IC 曲线**（09:45~14:55 各时点采截面算 RankIC，回答「因子信息何时最强」）；回测 **execute_at 执行时点**（next_close=次日收盘成交 / 尾盘=信号日收盘成交 / next_open=次日开盘成交：新仓按开→收、存量持仓按收→收、卖出按隔夜收→开计收益）；因子库「日内高频」类别预置 14 个因子，批量扫描自动分流；工作流「因子构建（分钟）」节点 |
| **策略回测** | 向量化回测、绩效指标、净值/回撤曲线（工作流回测节点 + QUBE 策略工作台）；**仅普通股票多头**（`normalize` 固定为 `long_only`，总仓位 ≤ 100%，负信号视为不买入，不融资/不融券/不做空）；支持可选基准对比（如 `000300.SH`）；**交易成本拆分**（佣金/滑点/印花税分列金额、占比与 bps/换手）；**容量分析**（信号在参与率约束下可容纳的资金规模，逐档资金规模给出受限天数比例与理论容量上限；ADV 窗口可调，assumptions 明示 A 股整手/涨跌停/冲击成本未模拟项）；**回测风格归因**（回测记录页一键运行：组合收益 ~ Σ β×风格因子收益 + alpha，回答「策略赚的钱来自哪种风格、剩的是不是纯 alpha」）；**参数敏感性**（网格扫描：佣金/滑点/印花税/止盈止损逐组合回测对比，验证策略稳健性）；**退市强制清算**（数据提前截止的持仓按末日价 ×(1-`delisting_loss`) 变现，`delisting_events` 明细 + assumptions 明示，杜绝「死股冻结不实现损失」）；**复牌跳空收益**（收益率前向填充口径，停牌损失如实入账） |
| **QUBE 策略 Agent** | 多轮对话设计策略的 AI Agent（pi-agent-core 风格工具调用循环），能读文档/样本数据、写代码、跑回测、存策略；右侧策略工作台分屏（代码/回测/日志/版本 + AI 优化/自动优化）；配置与设置页 AI 完全独立 |
| **策略库** | 工作中 / 已保存两态；QUBE 对话与工作流产出默认「工作中」，仅用户可手动设为「已保存」；策略代码版本历史可回滚 |
| **实验管理** | 实验记录、多实验对比、研究日志；回测与工作流运行完成后自动创建实验记录并关联 source_id |
| **风险与组合分析** | 风格暴露（Barra 精简）/ 组合优化（SLSQP 带约束）/ 绩效补充指标（alpha·beta/上下行捕获/Active Share）/ 压力测试（含**历史情景回放**：2015 股灾/2018 熊市/2024 小微盘危机等真实窗口 × 当前权重）/ **组合事前风险预测**（风格+行业因子协方差 → 预测波动 + 因子风险贡献分解）；**回测归因含行业因子**（均值偏离编码，回答「超额来自行业还是选股」）；组合优化仅允许纯多头；**块自助蒙特卡洛**（保留自相关与波动聚集）；支持**从本地行情缓存加载面板**（股票池+区间，前复权）与**回测记录风格归因**（回归法，`/api/risk/attribution-run`） |
...

- **因子编写**：公式/代码两种方式共用一套字段与量化算子；除量价外，研究/公式路径还注入 **基本面 fund_*（按公告日点位）、market_cap / turnover（需股本快照）、行业映射（供 INDUSTRY_NEUTRALIZE）**，并据快照现状动态标注可用性（无数据可取时求值会明确报错而非静默给错值）。因子库 Alpha 公式可直接粘到「因子构建（公式）」工作流节点运行（节点按股票池+区间自取 QMT 行情，并输出 return_data 供 IC/分组收益节点直连）。详见 [docs/因子编写指南.md](docs/因子编写指南.md)，因子库内可点「变量参考」查看。
- **工作流因子链路**：因子构建（公式/代码）→ 因子标准化/中性化 → 因子分析（一站式）/ 因子分析（AlphaLens）/ IC 计算 / 分组收益 / 因子衰减 均基于 QMT 行情面板做**截面**计算。自研「因子分析」与因子研究页**同源**（同一套 factor_research 服务）；「因子分析（AlphaLens）」调用 alphalens-reloaded 产出行业分组 IC/分层收益等。两个分析节点均可在节点上点「显示分析结果」直接弹出报告。
- **回测节点**：向量化回测，默认成本佣金率 0.001 / 滑点 0.001 / 卖出印花税 0.0005（与回测接口、QUBE 一致），T 日信号 T+1 收盘成交（信号当日与建仓当日均不计收益），输出净值/回撤曲线与完整绩效（年化收益/波动/夏普/索提诺/卡玛/最大回撤/VaR/CVaR/胜率/盈亏比/月度收益），支持可选基准对比（跟踪误差/信息比率）。**投资边界固定为普通多头**：正信号按日归一为满仓组合，总仓位 ≤ 100%；负信号视为不买入；不融资、不融券、不做空。逐仓风控（止盈/止损/移动止损）仅作用于多头持仓；停牌/一字板导致调仓无法成交时不推演挂单（持仓保持，次数在 assumptions 明示），且冻结旧仓挤占预算时买入按预算缩减，任何情况下总仓位不越界（缩减天数见 `leverage_summary`）。成本明细拆分输出（佣金/滑点/印花税分列）。
- **因子样本外验证节点**：walk-forward 滚动锚定分割（训练 [0,t) → 测试 [t, t+test) 逐折后移），输出每折 in-sample IC 与 OOS IC/分层多空统计量、聚合 OOS IC 均值/t 值/同向一致性/衰减，防过拟合（多空统计量仅供研究诊断，不代表可交易做空）。
- **市场环境节点能力**：`/api/regime/overview` 基于本地指数日线缓存输出宽基趋势状态（MA20/MA60/动量/HV20 联合判定牛/震荡/熊）、风格轮动（小盘/成长/中盘 vs 大盘 20 日相对强弱），数据中心顶部仪表盘展示。
- **工作流日志**：支持按级别、按节点 / 全局筛选与时间正序 / 倒序排序。

# 公式求值命名空间与规范化现状审查报告

## 1. 命名空间构造（`backend/services/factor_operators.py::build_operator_namespace`）

**位置**: `factor_operators.py:907-1135`。返回字典包含：

- **量价变量（大小写双注册，L936-963）**: `open/high/low/close/volume/amount/vwap`、派生 `returns/RETURNS_/adv20/ADV20`、`market_cap/MARKET_CAP`、`turnover/TURNOVER`。
- **基本面**: 仅当传入 `fundamental` 字典时注入 `fund_*` 及其大写（L962-963），否则**不存在**。
- **算子**: L967-1114 共约 **113 个大写键** + 同数小写别名 ≈ 226 个可调用名。类别覆盖：截面(RANK/SCALE/ZSCORE)、时序(DELAY/MA/EMA/WMA/SMA/DMA/DECAYLINEAR)、统计(STD/VAR/CORR/COV/TS_SKEW/TS_KURT)、条件(IF/EQUAL/VALUEWHEN/CROSS/LONGCROSS/LAST/COUNT/EVERY/EXIST/BARSLAST)、回归(REGRESI/REGBETA/TS_REGRESSION)、技术指标(MACD/RSI/KDJ/ATR/CCI/BOLL/DMI/OBV 等)、数学(ABS/LOG/POWER/SIGN/SIN/COS/TAN/ARCSIN/ARCCOS/ARCTAN/SIGNEDPOWER)。
- **已存在**: `IF`(L1050), `MAX`(L1042), `MIN`(L1043), `ABS`(L968), `POWER`(L973)。
- **不存在**: `SEQUENCE`/`sequence`、`DTM`、`DBM`、`TR`（只有 `ATR`）、`RET`/`ret`（只有 `RETURNS`/`RETURNS_`）、`VOL`/`vol`（只有 `VOLUME`）、`CAP`（只有 `MARKET_CAP`）、`CLOSE5`/`OPEN5`、`adjust_factor`（仅在 data cache 列里，未注入 ns）。

## 3. 现有规范化/翻译

- **唯一的公式字符串处理**: `factor_research.py:108-145` `formula_to_latex`，其 L116 `expr = formula.replace("**", "^")` 是把 Python `**` 转 LaTeX `^`，方向与需求相反，且只用于前端渲染，**不参与求值**。
- **求值前没有任何 `re.sub` / `.replace` 把 Alpha191 方言 (`?:`、`||`、`&&`、单 `=`、`./`、`.*`、`^`) 翻译成 Python**。`docs/因子编写指南.md` 第 93/116/286 行示例统一使用函数式 `IF(cond,a,b)`，文档未声明支持三元 `? :`、逻辑 `&&/||`、MATLAB 点除/点乘或 `^` 幂；幂运算要求用 `POWER(x,n)`（指南 L206）。
- 因此用户提到的 Alpha191 方言目前**完全不会被规范化**，eval 会直接抛 SyntaxError 或语义错误。

The user wants to start fixing P0-2: the executability issues of preset factor formulas. Let me recall the P0-2 proposal from the DeepSeek session:

### P0-2 Preset Factor Library: Many formulas are actually non-executable, and the misclassification is misleading

**Empirical evidence**

Parsed the 622 preset factors:

- 276 have formulas;
- Of these, **33 have Python syntax errors**: Alpha191's `cond ? a : b`, `||`, `=`, MATLAB-style `./`/`.*`, etc. have not been converted;
- **10 contain `^`**: Python interprets this as bitwise XOR, causing runtime errors or incorrect values;
- At least **9 daily-frequency formulas reference undefined variables**: `ret`, `vol`, `CLOSE5`, `OPEN5`, `CAP`, `sequence`;
- The remaining 346 factors have no local formulas, but the detail page still shows "Recalculate", and the recalculation results are uniformly labeled as "insufficient data", when in reality it's missing formulas / syntax errors.

"Factor library formulas can be pasted and run directly" currently does not hold.

**Proposed fix**

1. Add a new `formula_normalizer` translation layer, performing only deterministic dialect translation:
   - `a ? b : c` → `IF(a, b, c)`
   - `||` → `|`, `&&` → `&`
   - Comparison-type `=` → `==`
   - Power operator `^` → `**`
   - MATLAB's `./`, `.*` → `/`, `*`
   - Define compatibility aliases: `ret`, `vol`, and supplement the intermediate quantities that Alpha191 depends on like DTM/DBM/TR
2. Add/derive an executability metadata to the preset factor table:
   - `formula_status`: `executable` / `syntax_error` / `unsupported` / `missing_formula` / `needs_fundamental`;
   - Batch-verify when the factor library is imported, so that non-executable factors are not disguised as recalculable.
3. Make `recalculate_preset_factor` return structured errors:
   - `syntax_error` / `runtime_error` / `unsupported_formula` / `insufficient_data`;
   - Only write `metric_source=local_recalc` when recalculation truly succeeds.
4. For non-formula factors (parameterized indicators like DI2 etc.), either bind them to code generation by existing technical indicator operators, or explicitly mark them as "indicators, currently cannot be locally recalculated" in the UI and disable the recalculate button.
5. Cleanup of factor pool invariants:
   - The pool currently contains local_recalc factors with 120 samples, which is below the 300-ticker threshold that the system itself stipulates;
   - In addition to verification at pool insertion, **re-verify when the portfolio backtest consumes the factor pool**, automatically quarantine non-conforming factors and warn, so they don't directly enter backtests.

183	async def fetch_categories(client: httpx.AsyncClient, token: str) -> list[dict]:
184	    """获取分类列表（无需认证）"""
185	    print("[1/3] 获取因子分类列表...")
186	    headers = get_headers(token)

188	    resp.raise_for_status()
189	    data = resp.json()
190	
191	    # 解析返回格式: {"code": "200", "data": {"categoryTotal": 608, "list": [...]}}
192	    items = []
193	    if isinstance(data, dict):
194	        raw_data = data.get("data") or {}
195	        if isinstance(raw_data, dict):
196	            items = raw_data.get("list") or []
197	        elif isinstance(raw_data, list):
198	            items = raw_data
199	
200	    if not items:
201	        print("  ⚠️  API 未返回分类数据，使用备用分类列表")
202	        return FALLBACK_CATEGORIES
203	
204	    print(f"  ✅ 获取到 {len(items)} 个分类")
205	    for cat in items:
206	        print(
207	            f"     - {cat.get('categoryName', '?')} ({cat.get('categoryCode', '?')}): {cat.get('factorCount', '?')} 个因子"
208	        )
209	    return items

212	async def fetch_all_factors(client: httpx.AsyncClient, token: str) -> list[dict]:
213	    """
214	    获取全部因子数据。
215	    优先尝试一次性拉取全量（categoryCode 为空），
216	    若失败则回退到按分类分页获取。
217	    """
218	    print("\n[2/3] 获取全部因子列表...")
219	    headers = get_headers(token)
220	
221	    # 方式1：一次性获取全量
222	    payload = {
223	        "page": 1,
224	        "pageSize": 200,
225	        "categoryCode": "",
226	        "market": "A",
227	        "period": "近一年",
228	        "sortField": "RANK_IC",
229	        "sortOrder": "desc",
230	    }
231	
232	    try:
233	        resp = await client.post(
234	            FACTOR_LIST_API, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=60
235	        )
236	        resp.raise_for_status()
237	        data = resp.json()
238	
239	        items, total = _parse_factor_response(data)
240	        if items:
241	            print(f"  ✅ 第 1 页获取到 {len(items)} 个因子（API 报告总数: {total}）")
242	            # 如果一次没拿完，继续分页
243	            if total > len(items):
244	                more = await _fetch_remaining(client, headers, total, len(items))
245	                items.extend(more)
246	            return items
247	    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as e:
248	        print(
249	            f"  ⚠️  一次性获取失败 (HTTP {e.response.status_code})，回退到按分类分页获取..."
250	        )
251	    except Exception as e:
252	        print(f"  ⚠️  一次性获取失败: {e}，回退到按分类分页获取...")
253	
254	    # 方式2：按分类分页获取
255	    return await fetch_factors_by_category(client, token)

258	async def _fetch_remaining(
259	    client: httpx.AsyncClient, headers: dict, total: int, fetched_count: int
260	) -> list[dict]:
261	    """继续分页获取剩余因子"""
262	    items = []
263	    page = 2  # 第 1 页已获取
264	    page_size = 200  # API 实际最大返回 200 条
265	    while fetched_count + len(items) < total:
266	        payload = {
267	            "page": page,
268	            "pageSize": page_size,
269	            "categoryCode": "",
270	            "market": "A",
271	            "period": "近一年",
272	            "sortField": "RANK_IC",
273	            "sortOrder": "desc",
274	        }
275	        resp = await client.post(
276	            FACTOR_LIST_API, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=60
277	        )
278	        resp.raise_for_status()
279	        data = resp.json()
280	        page_items, _ = _parse_factor_response(data)
281	        if not page_items:
282	            break
283	        items.extend(page_items)
284	        print(
285	            f"      第 {page} 页: 获取 {len(page_items)} 条（累计 {fetched_count + len(items)}/{total}）"
286	        )
287	        if len(page_items) < page_size:
288	            break
289	        page += 1
290	    return items

293	async def fetch_factors_by_category(
294	    client: httpx.AsyncClient, token: str
295	) -> list[dict]:
296	    """按分类分页获取全部因子"""
297	    headers = get_headers(token)
298	    categories = await fetch_categories(client, token)
299	    all_factors = []
300	
301	    for idx, cat in enumerate(categories, 1):
302	        code = cat.get("categoryCode", "")
303	        name = cat.get("categoryName", "")
304	        expected = cat.get("factorCount", 0)
305	        print(
306	            f"\n  [{idx}/{len(categories)}] 分类: {name} ({code})，预期 {expected} 个因子"
307	        )
308	
309	        page = 1
310	        cat_factors = []
311	
312	        while True:
313	            payload = {
314	                "page": page,
315	                "pageSize": PAGE_SIZE,
316	                "categoryCode": code,
317	                "market": "A",
318	                "period": "近一年",
319	                "sortField": "RANK_IC",
320	                "sortOrder": "desc",
321	            }
322	
323	            resp = await client.post(
324	                FACTOR_LIST_API, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=60
325	            )
326	            resp.raise_for_status()
327	            data = resp.json()
328	
329	            items, total = _parse_factor_response(data)
330	            if not items:
331	                break
332	
333	            cat_factors.extend(items)
334	            print(
335	                f"      第 {page} 页: 获取 {len(items)} 条（累计 {len(cat_factors)}/{total}）"
336	            )
337	
338	            if len(cat_factors) >= total or len(items) < PAGE_SIZE:
339	                break
340	            page += 1
341	
342	        print(f"    ✅ {name}: 共获取 {len(cat_factors)} 个因子")
343	        all_factors.extend(cat_factors)
344	
345	    return all_factors

347	
348	def _parse_factor_response(data: dict) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
349	    """解析因子列表 API 返回数据，返回 (items, total)"""
350	    items = []
351	    total = 0
352	    if isinstance(data, dict):
353	        raw = data.get("data") or data.get("result") or {}
354	        if isinstance(raw, dict):
355	            items = raw.get("list") or raw.get("items") or raw.get("records") or []
356	            total = raw.get("total", len(items))
357	        elif isinstance(raw, list):
358	            items = raw
359	            total = len(items)
360	    return items, total

447	def verify_data(conn: sqlite3.Connection):
448	    """验证入库数据"""
449	    cur = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preset_factors")
450	    factor_count = cur.fetchone()[0]
451	    cur = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preset_factor_categories")
452	    cat_count = cur.fetchone()[0]
453	    cur = conn.execute("""
454	        SELECT category_code, category_name, factor_count,
455	               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preset_factors pf WHERE pf.category_code = pfc.category_code) as actual_count
456	        FROM preset_factor_categories pfc
457	        ORDER BY factor_count DESC
458	    """)
459	    print("\n📊 入库验证:")
460	    print(f"   preset_factor_categories: {cat_count} 条分类")
461	    print(f"   preset_factors:           {factor_count} 条因子")
462	    print()
463	    print("   各分类因子数量 (预期 / 实际):")
464	    for row in cur.fetchall():
465	        status = "✅" if row[2] == row[3] else "⚠️"
466	        print(f"   {status} {row[1]:<16} ({row[0]}): {row[2]:>3} / {row[3]:>3}")

121	        if re.match(r"[A-Za-z_]", tok):
122	            low = tok.lower()
123	            if nxt == "(":
124	                op_name = _LATEX_FUNCS.get(low, low.replace("_", "\\_"))
125	                if op_name.startswith(("\\\\", "\\")):
126	                    out.append(op_name)
127	                else:
128	                    out.append(f"\\operatorname{{{op_name}}}")
129	            else:

131	        elif tok == "*":
132	            out.append("\\cdot")

136	            out.append("\\;:\\;")

144	            out.append("\\land")
145	        elif tok == "|":
146	            out.append("\\lor")
147	        else:
148	            out.append(tok)
149	    # 去重连续逻辑符（&& / || 各产生两个 token）

1590	    # ── 因子批量扫描（P1）─────────────────────────────────────
1591	
1592	    @staticmethod
1593	    def _scan_factor_metrics(
1594	        factor_df: pd.DataFrame,
1595	        return_data: pd.DataFrame,
1596	        periods: list[int] | None = None,
1597	        mask: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
1598	    ) -> dict:
1599	        """单因子的扫描指标：核心 IC 指标 + 分层多空（轻量，不做完整报告）
1600	
1601	        与 ic_analysis / quantile_analysis 同口径，保证扫描结果与详情页一致。
1602	        """
1603	        periods = periods or [1, 5, 10, 20]
1604	        ic = FactorResearchService().ic_analysis(
1605	            factor_df, return_data, periods=[periods[0]], mask=mask
1606	        )
1607	        base = ic.get(f"period_{periods[0]}", {})
1608	        quantile = FactorResearchService().quantile_analysis(
1609	            factor_df, return_data, n_groups=5, mask=mask
1610	        )
1611	        ls_series = quantile.get("long_short_series", [])
1612	        ls_cum = float(ls_series[-1]["cum_return"]) if ls_series else 0.0
1613	        spreads = [float(x["spread"]) for x in ls_series if x.get("spread") is not None]
1614	        n_ls = len(spreads)
1615	        if n_ls:
1616	            spread_arr = np.asarray(spreads, dtype=float)
1617	            annual_return = float((1.0 + ls_cum) ** (252.0 / n_ls) - 1.0)
1618	            vol = float(spread_arr.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(252)) if n_ls > 1 else 0.0
1619	            sharpe = float(spread_arr.mean() / spread_arr.std(ddof=1) * np.sqrt(252)) if n_ls > 1 and spread_arr.std(ddof=1) > 0 else 0.0
1620	            nav = 1.0 + np.asarray([x["cum_return"] for x in ls_series], dtype=float)
1621	            max_dd = float((nav / np.maximum.accumulate(nav) - 1.0).min())
1622	        else:
1623	            annual_return = 0.0
1624	            vol = 0.0
1625	            sharpe = 0.0
1626	            max_dd = 0.0
1627	        return {
1628	            "ic_mean": float(base.get("ic_mean", 0.0)),
1629	            "rank_ic": float(base.get("rank_ic_mean", 0.0)),
1630	            "ic_ir": float(base.get("ic_ir", 0.0)),
1631	            "ic_std": float(base.get("ic_std", 0.0)),
1632	            "t_stat": float(base.get("ic_tstat", 0.0)),
1633	            "positive_ratio": float(base.get("ic_positive_ratio", 0.0)),
1634	            "n_cross_sections": len(base.get("ic_series", [])),
1635	            "long_short_cum": ls_cum,
1636	            "monotonicity": float(quantile.get("monotonicity", 0.0)),
1637	            "annualized_return": annual_return,
1638	            "maximum_drawdown": max_dd,
1639	            "sharpe_ratio": sharpe,
1640	            "long_short_vol": vol,
1641	        }

17	def _make_panels(n_dates: int = 400, n_stocks: int = 60, seed: int = 1):
18	    """合成面板：带一个已知动量信号的真实收益结构"""
19	    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
20	    dates = pd.bdate_range("2023-01-02", periods=n_dates)
21	    codes = [f"{600000 + i:06d}.SH" for i in range(n_stocks)]
22	
23	    # 因子：滚动 20 日动量 + 噪声；收益 = 0.03 * 昨日因子 + 噪声（T+1 生效）
24	    raw = pd.DataFrame(
25	        rng.normal(0, 1, size=(n_dates, n_stocks)), index=dates, columns=codes
26	    )
27	    factor = raw.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
28	    noise = rng.normal(0, 0.02, size=(n_dates, n_stocks))
29	    ret = pd.DataFrame(noise, index=dates, columns=codes) + 0.03 * factor.shift(1)
30	    close = (1 + ret.fillna(0)).cumprod()
31	    volume = pd.DataFrame(
32	        rng.uniform(1e6, 1e7, size=(n_dates, n_stocks)), index=dates, columns=codes
33	    )
34	    return factor, close, volume

## 3. 现有规范化/翻译

- **唯一的公式字符串处理**: `factor_research.py:108-145` `formula_to_latex`，其 L116 `expr = formula.replace("**", "^")` 是把 Python `**` 转 LaTeX `^`，方向与需求相反，且只用于前端渲染，**不参与求值**。
- **求值前没有任何 `re.sub` / `.replace` 把 Alpha191 方言 (`?:`、`||`、`&&`、单 `=`、`./`、`.*`、`^`) 翻译成 Python**。`docs/因子编写指南.md` 第 93/116/286 行示例统一使用函数式 `IF(cond,a,b)`，文档未声明支持三元 `? :`、逻辑 `&&/||`、MATLAB 点除/点乘或 `^` 幂；幂运算要求用 `POWER(x,n)`（指南 L206）。
- 因此用户提到的 Alpha191 方言目前**完全不会被规范化**，eval 会直接抛 SyntaxError 或语义错误。

#### Thinking

Two important discoveries that differ from the audit's premises:
1. The table is not `factors` but **`preset_factors`**, and **there is no `formula` column** — the formula is embedded in `description` and extracted via markers (like "公式是：").
2. Preset factors are fetched from external sites by a manual scraping script, and there is no automatic seeding on startup.

I'll fix my own reproduction script with the correct schema. Also, to check what the formula looks like, I'll investigate the description field as well.

I found that the preset factors are stored in the `preset_factors` table with formulas embedded in the `description` field rather than in a dedicated column. Let me verify this with the actual schema.

#### Thinking

The audit's claims have been accurately verified:
- 622 preset factors, of which 276 have formulas and 346 do not
- **33 syntax errors** (22 use `?` ternary operator, 4 use `=` + `?`, 1 uses `||`, 2 use matlab-style `./.*`, 3 other, 1 uses `^`+`?`)
- **9 more pass syntax check but contain `^`** (XOR semantics bug — actually these are worse than syntax errors: they silently compute wrong values)
- Missing names: `ret` (8), `sequence` (3), `vol` (2), `CLOSE5`/`OPEN5` (alpha054), `CAP` (alpha056) — the intraday ones (ID_*, TAIL_RET, m_volume...) are **intraday namespace** names, not missing — they exist in build_intraday_namespace, and my check only built the daily namespace. So the real daily-frequency gaps are: ret (8), sequence (3), vol (2), CLOSE5/OPEN5 (1 factor), CAP (1 factor). This matches the audit's "at least 9" (8+3+2+1+1 = 15 name occurrences spanning roughly 10 factors).

Note: alpha191_172/186 also reference `ld`, `hd`, `tr` — did these show up? In the syntax error list (they contain `?`). Once `?` is normalized, we'll also need `ld`/`hd`/`tr` (DMI intermediate values). Confirmed: alpha191_172: `sum((ld>0 & ld>hd)?ld:0,14)*100/sum(tr,14)` — uses ld, hd, tr. So the normalizer needs to provide DTM→ld? Actually in the Alpha191 spec: hd = high - delay(high,1); ld = delay(low,1) - low; tr = sum of true range... The Alpha191 definitions:
- alpha191_172/186 use ld, hd, tr in MEAN/ATR-like forms. In the original Alpha191 spec:
  - TR = true range sum? Actually in gtja's alpha191: ld = LOW - DELAY(LOW,1)... let's not derive now — during implementation we'll need to define these intermediate values per the Alpha191 paper. The audit suggested "supplement intermediate values like DTM/DBM/TR that Alpha191 depends on".

Next, the design question. User's request: "start fixing P0-2 syntax errors" — focus on syntax errors. The full P0-2 proposal had 5 items (normalizer, formula_status metadata, structured errors, UI marking for non-formula factors, pool invariants). The user narrowed it: syntax errors. But let me think about what a minimal consistent unit is:

Core: a deterministic dialect normalizer `normalize_formula(formula) -> str` applied at eval time (not at storage), plus aliases for common missing names (ret/vol aliases; sequence; CAP→MARKET_CAP; CLOSE5/OPEN5 = DELAY(close,5)/DELAY(open,5); ld/hd/tr/dtm/dbm intermediates as namespace functions or pre-computed panels?).

Key design decisions:

**A. Where to normalize: at eval time vs at storage time.**
- At eval time: a single function `normalize_formula` wrapped at every eval site (or better: inside a single eval helper). Formulas in the DB remain the original scraped text (traceable back to source), display shows original + can show normalized version. All eval paths (recalc, batch scan, portfolio backtest, workflow node, QUBE) get the fix by sharing one code path.
- At storage time: rewrites description — loses source fidelity, requires migration, and re-scraping would re-break.
→ **Eval-time normalization** is clearly better. The audit also proposed "add a new formula_normalizer translation layer" — at eval time.

Where is the single chokepoint? There are about 13 eval sites listed. Best move: introduce `eval_factor_formula(formula, ns)` in factor_operators.py (or a new module) that does normalize + eval, and replace all daily-frequency eval sites to call it. That's the "no reinventing the wheel + single injection point" approach.

**B. Normalizer rules (deterministic dialect translation):**
1. Ternary `cond ? a : b` → `IF(cond, a, b)` — needs proper parsing (nested ternary, paren matching). Regex is fragile; a small recursive parser over tokens, or iterative innermost-replacement: repeatedly find innermost `?` (one with no `?` between it and the matching `:`)... The classical approach: scan for the pattern `(X ? Y : Z)` with regex `\(([^()]*)\?([^()]*)\:([^()]*)\)` and loop until no more matches — but Alpha191 ternaries aren't always parenthesized at the ternary level (e.g. `sma((((close>delay(close,1))?1/...`: the ternary's condition part is parenthesized). Hmm. Look at alpha191_164: `sma((((close>delay(close,1))?1/(close-delay(close,1)):1)-...` — ternary `((close>delay(close,1)) ? 1/(close-delay(close,1)) : 1)`. This ternary itself is wrapped in parens. Common structure: parens around the whole ternary. But alpha191_180: `((mean(volume,20) < volume) ? ((-1 * tsrank(...)) *sign(...) : (-1 * ...))` — outer parens wrap the ternary.

Robust approach: token-based recursive descent parsing of ternary: find `?` at lowest nesting depth and its matching `:`... Actually a well-known trick: process innermost first: find `?` and expand outward from there to find the ternary's bounds at that paren depth. Since all 33 formulas come from one scraper source (pandaaiquant), the dialect is consistent: Alpha191-style with `(...)?...:...` mostly parenthesized. I can implement a scanner:
- Find the first `?` not inside a string; from there walk backward at the same paren depth to the ternary start (open paren or expression start); walk forward to find the matching `:` at same depth, then walk to the end. Replace with IF(cond,a,b). Iterate until no `?` left.
This is implementable and unit-testable against all 33 real formulas (golden test: all 33 normalize to syntactically valid Python).

2. `||` → `|`, `&&` → `&` (elementwise on boolean DataFrames). Careful: `|`/`&` have higher precedence than comparisons in Python! `a > b | c > d` mis-parses. Alpha191 formulas like `(ld>0 & ld>hd)` — after `&` substitution: `(ld>0 & ld>hd)` → in Python: `ld > (0 & ld) > hd` — wrong! Original Alpha191 semantics: `(ld>0) & (ld>hd)`. So we need to parenthesize comparisons around `&`/`|`: convert `X & Y` to `(X) & (Y)` where X/Y are comparison expressions... This is trickier. How many formulas use &/||? From stats: only 1 with `||` (alpha191_098), and alpha191_172/186 use `&` (they were in the syntax-error bucket due to `?`, but also contain `&`). So total affected ≤ 3 formulas. For such a small set, a practical approach: after ternary conversion, add explicit parens around `&`/`|` operands via a regex pass that wraps comparison expressions. Or even more pragmatically: in the golden tests, ensure these specific formulas evaluate to values matching a hand-derived reference. Hmm — but general correctness matters more than these 3. Let me think: token-based approach: after ternary normalization, scan for `&`/`|`; for each operand boundary, wrap the maximal comparison subexpression in parens. Implementation: regex-based parenthesization: replace `([A-Za-z_][\w().]*\s*[<>=!]+\s*[^&|()]+)` ... gets messy.

Cleaner alternative for &/|: first do ternary replacement, then for `&`/`|` use the fact that operands in these formulas are comparison expressions of the form `expr OP expr`. Targeted transform: `(\w+\s*(?:>|<|>=|<=|=|==)\s*\w+)` → `(\1)` before replacing && → &? E.g. `ld>0 & ld>hd` → wrap each comparison: `(ld>0) & (ld>hd)` ✓. And alpha191_098: `((delta(...) / 100) < 0.05) || ((delta(...) ...) < 0.05)` — operands already parenthesized; wrapping comparisons only when unparenthesized works. Implement carefully with tests.

3. Single `=` comparison → `==`: only when not part of `==`, `>=`, `<=`, `!=`. Regex: `(?<![=!<>+\-*/&|])=(?![=])` → `==`. But careful with `:=` or kwarg `=`? These formulas don't have kwargs. alpha191_059: `close=delay(close,1)?0:...` → `close==delay(close,1)?0:...` before ternary conversion. Order matters: first `=`→`==`, then ternary.

4. `^` → `**`: on DataFrames `^` is bitwise XOR — wrong. All 9 cases + 1 in the syntax-error bucket. Regex `\^` → `**`. Careful: none of these formulas use `**` already... if any did, replacing ^ is still fine.

5. MATLAB `./` → `/`, `.*` → `*`: regex `\./` → `/`, `\.\*` → `*`. But careful: `.*` as regex metachar in the source? No, in the formula string it's literal. Also `1.*volume` → `1*volume` ✓. And don't break decimals like `0.5`? `.*` needs `*` after the dot — `0.5` is safe. But a formula ending in `2.` followed by `*`? Unlikely; use lookarounds: `(?<=\d)\.(?=\*)`? Hmm — `.*` appears in expressions like `(high-low).*volume`. Regex `\.\*` → `*` could break `0.5*2`? No: `0.5*2` contains `5*`, not `.*`. The pattern `\.\*` matches only literal dot followed by star. In `0.5*2`, the char after the dot is `5`, not `*`. Safe. Same for `\./` → `/` in `./`: `0.5/2` is safe.

108	def formula_to_latex(formula: str) -> str:
109	    """将因子公式字符串转为 LaTeX 表达式（供前端 KaTeX 渲染）
110	
111	    策略：逐 token 映射 —— 函数名转 \\operatorname，变量转 \\text，
112	    乘号转 \\cdot，保留括号结构；不做完整语法解析，保证鲁棒。
113	    """
114	    if not formula:
115	        return ""
116	    expr = formula.replace("**", "^")
117	    tokens = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|\d+\.?\d*|[^\sA-Za-z0-9_]", expr)
118	    out: list[str] = []
119	    for i, tok in enumerate(tokens):
120	        nxt = tokens[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(tokens) else ""
121	        if re.match(r"[A-Za-z_]", tok):
122	            low = tok.lower()
123	            if nxt == "(":
124	                op_name = _LATEX_FUNCS.get(low, low.replace("_", "\\_"))
125	                if op_name.startswith(("\\\\", "\\")):
126	                    out.append(op_name)
127	                else:
128	                    out.append(f"\\operatorname{{{op_name}}}")
129	            else:
130	                out.append(f"\\text{{{tok.lower().replace('_', chr(92) + '_')}}}")
131	        elif tok == "*":
132	            out.append("\\cdot")
133	        elif tok == "?":
134	            out.append("\\;?\\;")
135	        elif tok == ":":
136	            out.append("\\;:\\;")
137	        elif tok == "<" and nxt == "=":
138	            out.append("\\le")
139	        elif tok == ">" and nxt == "=":
140	            out.append("\\ge")
141	        elif tok == "=" and out and out[-1] in ("\\le", "\\ge"):
142	            continue
143	        elif tok == "&":
144	            out.append("\\land")
145	        elif tok == "|":
146	            out.append("\\lor")
147	        else:
148	            out.append(tok)
149	    # 去重连续逻辑符（&& / || 各产生两个 token）
150	    cleaned: list[str] = []
151	    for tok in out:
152	        if tok in ("\\land", "\\lor") and cleaned and cleaned[-1] == tok:
153	            continue
154	        cleaned.append(tok)
155	    return " ".join(cleaned)

Now I have a grasp of the overall picture of the eval sites. There are about 18 eval sites. Important nuance: some are "formula" evals (single expression, safe to normalize), while others are "code" evals (multi-line, `lines[-1]` after exec — user code, must not normalize). Examples: routes/factor.py:285 evaluates the last line of code after executing the preceding lines; qube_research:196 evaluates the entire code. Normalization must only be applied to formula expressions, never to free-form Python code. Design: `normalize_formula(s)` is applied at the point where the input is known to be a formula expression (the single-expression branch of the preset factor's formula + formula node). Even in the case of "code" (multi-line), the last expression line is a formula, but... it's risky — user code can define variables and so on. The normalizer's transformations (^→**, ?:→IF, ||→|, =→==) could break valid Python code where `=` is assignment! Example: `x = close/delay(close,5)` — in user code mode, the `=`→`==` conversion destroys the assignment. Therefore: normalize only in pure formula contexts (preset factor formulas, "formula" mode of the formula node), do not normalize in code contexts.

Where is the "formula vs code" distinction? factor_build.py L141-143: `if code exists → exec path, otherwise eval(formula)`. routes/factor.py L974/976 is the same pattern. In other words, the `else` branch (pure formula) is the normalization target.

Next, the SEQUENCE issue: `regbeta(mean(close,6),sequence(6))` — REGBETA(a, b, n) expects b to be a DataFrame; sequence(6) should be a ramp 1..6 aligned to each rolling window. In the gtja reference implementation, SEQUENCE returns np.arange, and their REGBETA handles rolling regression of y against a fixed x window. Our vectorized REGBETA does COV(a,b,n)/VAR(b,n) — if b is a constant ramp... b needs to be a DataFrame of rolling ramp values. Trick: build b as a per-window ramp: for each column, ramp = (arange(n) repeated)... The standard approach for vectorization: b_panel = rolling position index = a counter 1..n within each window. There's a known trick: sequence values can be computed as the modulo of a cumulative counter, but... windows are fixed-length; the x values within any window are always [1,2,...,n]. cov(a, x) within window = Σ(a_i − ā)(i − (n+1)/2)/... Can be implemented with rolling apply, but slow; a better way: rolling cov of a against "time index" = rolling cov of a against arange via the formula cov(a,t) = (Σ t·a − Σt·Σa/n)/(Σt² − (Σt)²/n). Σt, Σt² are constants for fixed n. So the slope against the ramp = (Σ t·a − (n+1)/2·Σa) / (Σt² − (Σt)²/n) — Σ t·a within a window can be computed as rolling apply of weights [1..n] — i.e., a weighted sum: `a.rolling(n).apply(lambda w: w @ arange(1,n+1))` — O(n_days × n) per column, well within acceptable range. Or use convolution per column. A more concise implementation in our operator style:

#### Thinking

My quick regex prototype failed on most of the ternaries — because the ternary `(cond ? a : b)` contains nested parens inside cond/a/b, so the simple `\(([^()]*?)\?...\)` regex (no parens inside) only matches the trivially innermost ones. Need a proper paren-aware scanner. I understand the structure well enough, so let me write a better prototype right now and verify that all 33 can be fixed. The scanner: find each `?`; walk outward at the same paren depth to find the ternary's start and the matching `:` and the end. Standard algorithm:

For each `?` (processed left-to-right, innermost first — or if done with correct boundary detection, order doesn't matter):
- From the position of `?`, walk left, tracking depth (depth=0 at the `?` position); stop when you encounter a `(` such that closing it would make depth negative, or when you hit a ternary boundary (`,`, `(`, or start of string, or an already-inserted `IF(`). The cond starts right after that boundary.
- Walk right to find the matching `:` at the same depth as `?` (skip nested `?`/`:` pairs… careful: nested ternaries inside branches).
- Continue right to find the end of the `else` branch at the same depth: stop at a `)` that closes below the ternary's depth, or at `,`, or at end of string.

A simpler and more robust approach: recursive descent with an index parser. Or a trick that reliably handles nesting: repeat the following: find the first `?`; find its matching `:` by scanning right while counting `?`/`:` pairs (the colon that brings the nesting count back to zero); determine the operand boundaries at the "ternary depth" paren level: from `?` scan left, counting parens; the cond boundary is where the paren balance drops below the balance at `?` (i.e. the enclosing `(`) — but what if the ternary isn't wrapped in parens? E.g. `sum((close>delay(close,1)?0:...),12)` — the ternary `(close>delay(close,1)?0:...)` is wrapped. In all these Alpha191 formulas the ternary appears to be paren-wrapped (from gtja's format). But alpha191_180: `((mean(volume,20) < volume) ? (...) : (...))` wrapped ✓. alpha191_038 is also wrapped ✓. alpha191_128: `sum(((high+low+close)/3>delay(...)?(high+low+close)/3*volume:0),14)` wrapped ✓.

Let me define the algorithm concretely (paren-aware, innermost first):
1. Loop: find the first `?` whose interior region (between the enclosing parens) contains no other `?` — i.e., pick the innermost. Implementation: iterate over the positions of all `?`; for each, compute the substring bounds:
   - Left bound: scan left from `?`, balance=0; while scanning, `)` → balance+=1, `(` → if balance==0: stop (left bound = index+1), otherwise balance-=1. Also stop at `,` when balance==0 (left bound = index+1).
   - Colon: scan right from `?`, qcount=0: see `?` → qcount+=1; see `:` → if qcount==0 found the colon, else qcount-=1. Also respect parens: only count `?`/`:` at the same paren depth as the `?` — track depth: `(` depth+1, `)` depth−1; only count `?`/`:` when depth==depth at the `?` position.
   - Right bound: scan right from colon, balance=0 (relative), stopping at a `)` with balance==0 (right bound = index) or `,` with balance==0 (right bound=index) or end of string.
2. Replace `[left:right]` with `IF(cond,then,else)`.
3. Repeat until no `?` remains.

Edge case: a space after the `:` like `: (...)` — no problem, gets trimmed.
Edge case: ternary inside an argument list: `sum((X?Y:Z),12)` — left bound stops at `(` after `sum`, right bound stops at `)` before `,12` ✓.
Edge case: alpha191_069: `(sum(dtm,20)>sum(dbm,20)?(sum(dtm,20)-sum(dbm,20))/sum(dtm,20): (sum(dtm,20)==sum(dbm,20)? 0: (...)))` — nested ternary inside the else branch. Innermost first: the first `?` at depth 0 is the outer one… the inner `?` sits deeper inside parens. My "first ?" scan hits the outer one first, but the colon scan skips the nested `?:` pair (qcount handles it). Right bound of else: scan right from the outer colon: `(sum(dtm,20)==sum(dbm,20)? 0: (...))` — walking with balance, we consume the whole paren group and stop at the final `)` ✓. Then replace the outer → the inner remains, next iteration handles it ✓.

Edge case: alpha191_164 `((close>delay(close,1))?1/(close-delay(close,1)):1)` — the cond is wrapped in its own parens ✓ handled.

Also unary minus, and things like `sumif`. Then post-pass checks: ast.parse; report any that still fail (manual fix list).

alpha096: unbalanced parens (the scraper truncated or broke it: `MAX(...) * -1)` has an extra `)`). Count: the original text ends with `...), 14), 13)) * -1)`. Let me count parens in the full text… the error says "unmatched ')'". This is a data-quality issue, not a dialect issue. Options: auto-fix the trailing unbalanced `)` (strip extra closing parens / add missing ones)? A deterministic "paren-balancing" repair is risky but doable: if there are extra `)`, drop the surplus ones at positions that keep it parseable; if `(` is missing, append at the end. For just this one formula, a one-time hand-patch is also possible… but formulas live in the DB from the scraper, and a code-level generic repair is preferable. Paren-balance repair: if count(')') > count('('): iteratively try removing each surplus `)` from right to left until it parses (deterministic and few candidates). If `(` is more: append at end. Acceptable as a last-resort step with a note. alpha191_166: `(20-1)*(20-2)(sum(...` — juxtaposition `)( ` means implicit multiplication: insert `*` between `)` and `(`. Deterministic: insert `*` between `)` and `(`; also between a digit and `(`? Careful: `2(x)` isn't valid Python either; insert `*` between digit and `(` too? But function calls like `sum(` are name+paren, not digit+paren. Between `)` and `(`, and between `)` and a name, is safe? `)close` isn't common… Restrict to `)(` → `)*(` and `)(` after digit… let me check alpha191_166's full text later during implementation; only one formula.

So: SEQUENCE(n) returns a ramp array; bare `sequence` → also needs to be a callable/object. REGBETA must support both (a,b,n) and (a, ramp) signatures: if b is a ramp/sequence marker: n=len(ramp), compute the rolling slope of a against the ramp. Implementation via rolling weighted sum:
  slope_t = Σ_i (i−ī)(a_{t−n+1+i} − ā) / Σ_i (i−ī)²  where i=1..n (or 0..n-1).
  Efficiently: use `a.rolling(n).apply(lambda w: np.dot(w, ramp))` to compute rolling dot with the ramp — O(T×n×N) in a Python loop per column… apply is slow but n is small (6/12/20); 680 days × 120 stocks — fine.
  Actually cleaner: slope = (n·Σ(i·a) − Σi·Σa) / (n·Σi² − (Σi)²), Σ(i·a) via rolling.apply with weights arange(1,n+1). Implement REGBETA to detect sequence and handle it.

54	def _align_factor_return(
55	    factor_df: pd.DataFrame, return_df: pd.DataFrame
56	) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
57	    """把因子与收益面板对齐到共同的日期与股票上。
58	
59	    因子/收益面板可能来自不同来源（compute 接口、工作流节点、手工构造），
60	    日期索引错位时 IC/分层会把「未来日期」当 NaN 匹配，产生 500/空结果。
61	    统一在入口对齐：共同日期、共同股票，按日期升序。
62	    """
63	    common_dates = factor_df.index.intersection(return_df.index).sort_values()
64	    common_codes = factor_df.columns.intersection(return_df.columns)
65	    if len(common_dates) == 0 or len(common_codes) == 0:
66	        raise ValueError("因子与收益面板无共同日期或共同股票，请检查输入面板")
67	    return (
68	        factor_df.loc[common_dates, common_codes].sort_index(),
69	        return_df.loc[common_dates, common_codes].sort_index(),
70	    )

220	@router.post("/compute")
221	async def compute_factor(req: FactorComputeRequest):
222	    """基于本地行情数据计算因子值，同时返回远期收益供 IC/分层分析使用"""
223	    try:
224	        panels = market_data.load_price_panels(
225	            codes=req.stock_pool
226	            or market_data.list_cached_codes("1d", exclude_indices=True),
227	            start_date=req.start_date,
228	            end_date=req.end_date,
229	        )
230	    except ValueError as e:
231	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))
232	
233	    close = panels["close"]
234	    # 待注入的参考面板：市值 / 换手率（无股本快照则为 None，不注入避免误导取值）
235	    aug = dict(panels)
236	    try:
237	        from backend.services import reference_data
238	
239	        mc = reference_data.build_market_cap_panel(close)
240	        if mc is not None:
241	            aug["market_cap"] = mc
242	        turn = reference_data.build_turnover_panel(panels.get("volume"), close)
243	        if turn is not None:
244	            aug["turnover"] = turn
245	        industry_map = reference_data.load_industry_map()
246	    except Exception:
247	        logger.debug("市值/换手率/行业面板不可用，跳过注入", exc_info=True)
248	        mc, turn, industry_map = None, None, None
249	    # 基本面公告日点位：仅股票代码区间内已有快照记录的字段注入，避免 fund_xxx 无从取值
250	    fundamental_panels = {}
251	    try:
252	        from backend.services.fundamental import build_fundamental_panels
253	
254	        fundamental_panels = build_fundamental_panels(
255	            list(close.columns), close.index
256	        ) or {}
257	    except Exception:
258	        fundamental_panels = {}
259	    # 构建公式求值命名空间：基础字段 + vwap/returns + 全部量化算子
260	    # （RANK/DELAY/DELTA/CORR/TS_RANK/DECAYLINEAR 等，大小写均可），
261	    # 使因子库中的 Alpha101/Alpha191 公式可直接运行。
262	    from backend.services.factor_operators import build_operator_namespace
263	
264	    eval_ctx = build_operator_namespace(
265	        aug,
266	        industry_map=industry_map,
267	        fundamental={f"fund_{f}": p for f, p in fundamental_panels.items()},
268	    )
269	
270	    try:
271	        if req.mode == "formula":
272	            if not req.formula.strip():
273	                raise ValueError(
274	                    "因子公式为空，请输入表达式，如: RANK(close / DELAY(close, 5) - 1)"
275	                )
276	            # 支持多行公式：取最后一个非空表达式作为因子值（对齐官网中间变量写法）
277	            formula_lines = [
278	                ln
279	                for ln in req.formula.strip().splitlines()
280	                if ln.strip() and not ln.strip().startswith("#")
281	            ]
282	            if len(formula_lines) > 1:
283	                exec_ctx = dict(eval_ctx)
284	                exec("\n".join(formula_lines[:-1]), {"__builtins__": {}}, exec_ctx)  # noqa: S102
285	                factor = eval(formula_lines[-1], {"__builtins__": {}}, exec_ctx)
286	            else:
287	                factor = eval(req.formula, {"__builtins__": {}}, eval_ctx)
288	        else:
289	            if not req.code.strip():
290	                raise ValueError("因子代码为空")
291	            exec_ctx = dict(eval_ctx)
292	            exec(req.code, {"__builtins__": __builtins__}, exec_ctx)  # noqa: S102
293	            fn = exec_ctx.get("compute_factor")
294	            if callable(fn):
295	                factor = fn(close=close, volume=panels.get("volume"))
296	            else:
297	                factor = exec_ctx.get("factor_data")
298	            if factor is None:
299	                raise ValueError("代码未定义 compute_factor 函数或 factor_data 变量")
300	        if isinstance(factor, pd.Series):
301	            factor = factor.to_frame()
302	        if not isinstance(factor, pd.DataFrame):
303	            raise TypeError(
304	                f"因子计算结果应为 DataFrame，得到 {type(factor).__name__}"
305	            )
306	    except HTTPException:
307	        raise
308	    except ValueError as e:
309	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))
310	    except Exception as e:
311	        logger.error(f"因子计算失败: {e}")
312	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"因子计算失败: {e}")
313	
314	    factor = factor.dropna(how="all")
315	    if factor.empty:
316	        raise HTTPException(
317	            status_code=400, detail="因子计算结果为空（可能回看期超过数据长度）"
318	        )
319	
320	    # 收益面板统一为前向填充口径（与因子研究页/工作流节点一致）：
321	    # 停牌/缺口期间收益为 0，复牌日跳空收益计入。build_return_panel 保留完整
322	    # 日期索引（首日为 0），再与因子面板对齐，避免日期错位产生 NaN 截面。
323	    returns = market_data.build_return_panel(close)
324	    factor, returns = _align_factor_return(factor, returns)
325	
326	    from backend.services.panel_artifact import build_panel_response
327	
328	    # 全市场面板不要整表 JSON 回传：小样本内联，大样本落本地 artifact +
329	    # 受限预览；下游分析接口接受同一 token。
330	    return build_panel_response(
331	        {"factor_data": factor, "return_data": returns},
332	        inline_names=["factor_data", "return_data"],
333	    )

533	@router.post("/library")
534	async def register_factor(req: FactorCreate):
535	    factor_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
536	    now = int(time.time() * 1000)
537	    db = await get_db()
538	    # 同名因子版本自增（保留历史行，不覆盖），便于查看/回滚历史公式
539	    cursor = await db.execute(
540	        "SELECT MAX(version) FROM factors WHERE name = ?", (req.name,)
541	    )
542	    row = await cursor.fetchone()
543	    next_version = (row[0] or 0) + 1
544	    await db.execute(
545	        "INSERT INTO factors (id, name, description, category, formula, code, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
546	        (
547	            factor_id,
548	            req.name,
549	            req.description,
550	            req.category,
551	            req.formula,
552	            req.code,
553	            next_version,
554	            now,
555	            now,
556	        ),
557	    )
558	    await db.commit()
559	    await db.close()
560	
561	    # 注册后自动跑一次本地分析并存入实验表（最佳努力；数据不足则跳过，不阻断注册）
562	    analysis = {"ok": False, "message": "未分析"}
563	    try:
564	        formula = (req.formula or "").strip()
565	        if formula:
566	            analysis = factor_research.analyze_formula_on_local(formula)
567	            if analysis.get("ok"):
568	                from backend.models.experiment import ExperimentCreate
569	                from backend.services.experiment_service import experiment_service
570	
571	                await experiment_service.create(
572	                    ExperimentCreate(
573	                        source="factor",
574	                        source_id=factor_id,
575	                        name=f"{req.name} v{next_version}",
576	                        note="注册时自动指标快照",
577	                        tags=["factor", "register"],
578	                        params={"formula": formula, "version": next_version},
579	                        metrics=analysis["metrics"],
580	                    )
581	                )
582	    except Exception as e:
583	        logger.warning(f"自建因子注册分析快照失败（不影响注册）: {e}")
584	
585	    return {
586	        "id": factor_id,
587	        "name": req.name,
588	        "version": next_version,
589	        "analysis": analysis,
590	    }

754	@router.post("/validation")
755	async def walk_forward(req: WalkForwardRequest):
756	    """因子样本外验证：滚动锚定 train/test 分割，输出每折 in-sample 与 OOS 指标"""
757	    try:
758	        if req.formula:
759	            res = factor_research.eval_formula_on_local(
760	                req.formula, req.start_date, req.end_date
761	            )
762	            if not res.get("ok"):
763	                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=res.get("message", "公式求值失败"))
764	            factor_df, return_data, mask = (
765	                res["factor_df"],
766	                res["return_data"],
767	                res.get("mask"),
768	            )
769	        else:
770	            if not req.factor_data or not req.return_data:
771	                raise HTTPException(
772	                    status_code=400, detail="需提供 formula（本地求值）或 factor_data/return_data 面板"
773	                )
774	            factor_df = _dict_to_df(req.factor_data)
775	            return_data = _dict_to_df(req.return_data)
776	            mask = None
777	        result = factor_research.walk_forward_validation(
778	            factor_df,
779	            return_data,
780	            train_days=req.train_days,
781	            test_days=req.test_days,
782	            n_splits=req.n_splits,
783	            period=req.period,
784	            n_groups=req.n_groups,
785	            mask=mask,
786	        )
787	        # 溯源
788	        await _spawn_provenance(
789	            kind="factor",
790	            entity_id="validation",
791	            entity_name="walk-forward",
792	            params=req.model_dump(),
793	            metrics=result.get("aggregate", {}),
794	            notes=result.get("message", ""),
795	            source="validation",
796	        )
797	        return result
798	    except HTTPException:
799	        raise
800	    except Exception as e:
801	        logger.error(f"样本外验证失败: {e}")
802	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"样本外验证失败: {e}")

818	@router.post("/export-panel")
819	async def export_factor_panel(req: ExportPanelRequest):
820	    """导出因子值面板 CSV（index=日期, columns=股票）与前瞻收益面板
821	
822	    在本地缓存行情上重算因子并返回两份 CSV（factor_values.csv / return_data.csv），
823	    供离线复核、交付验证与外部工具分析。返回 JSON 的 data_urls 为可直接
824	    curl/浏览器下载的链接（GET /api/factor/export-file/{token}）。
825	    """
826	    import secrets
827	
828	    from backend.services.factor_research import extract_formula
829	
830	    formula = (req.formula or "").strip()
831	    if not formula and req.factor_id:
832	        db = await get_db()
833	        try:
834	            cursor = await db.execute(
835	                "SELECT description FROM preset_factors WHERE id = ?", (req.factor_id,)
836	            )
837	            row = await cursor.fetchone()
838	        finally:
839	            await db.close()
840	        if not row:
841	            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="因子不存在")
842	        formula = extract_formula(row["description"])

844	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="无可解析公式（请提供 formula 或有效的 factor_id）")
845	
846	    codes = req.stock_pool or market_data.list_cached_codes("1d", exclude_indices=True)
847	    if not codes:
848	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=market_data.no_cache_error_detail("因子导出"))
849	    res = await asyncio.to_thread(
850	        factor_research.eval_formula_on_local, formula, req.start_date, req.end_date
851	    )
852	    if not res.get("ok"):
853	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=res.get("message", "公式求值失败"))
854	    factor_df = res["factor_df"]
855	    return_data = res["return_data"]
856	
857	    token = secrets.token_hex(8)
858	    from backend.services.market_data import panel_to_dict
859	
860	    _EXPORT_BUCKET[token] = {
861	        "factor_values": panel_to_dict(factor_df),
862	        "return_data": panel_to_dict(return_data),
863	        "data_date": res.get("data_date"),
864	        "n_stocks": int(factor_df.shape[1]),
865	        "n_dates": int(factor_df.shape[0]),
866	    }
867	    return {
868	        "ok": True,
869	        "factor_id": req.factor_id,
870	        "data_date": res.get("data_date"),
871	        "n_stocks": int(factor_df.shape[1]),
872	        "n_dates": int(factor_df.shape[0]),
873	        "data_urls": {
874	            "factor_values": f"/api/factor/export-file/{token}?part=factor_values",
875	            "return_data": f"/api/factor/export-file/{token}?part=return_data",
876	        },
877	    }
878

880	_EXPORT_BUCKET: dict[str, dict] = {}

883	@router.get("/export-file/{token}")
884	async def export_file(token: str, part: str = "factor_values"):
885	    """下载导出的 CSV 数据（token 由 /export-panel 生成，内存暂存）"""
886	    from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
887	
888	    payload = _EXPORT_BUCKET.get(token)
889	    if not payload or part not in ("factor_values", "return_data"):
890	        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="导出数据不存在或已过期")
891	    import io
892	
893	    df = pd.DataFrame(payload[part])
894	    df.index = pd.to_datetime(df.index)
895	    df = df.sort_index()
896	
897	    def _generate():
898	        buf = io.StringIO()
899	        df.to_csv(buf)
900	        yield buf.getvalue()
901	
902	    fname = f"{part}.csv"
903	    return StreamingResponse(
904	        _generate(),
905	        media_type="text/csv; charset=utf-8",
906	        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{fname}"'},
907	    )

924	# ── 日内高频（分钟级）因子研究 ─────────────────────────────────────────
925	
926	
927	class IntradayComputeRequest(BaseModel):
928	    formula: str = ""
929	    stock_pool: list[str] = []
930	    start_date: str = ""
931	    end_date: str = ""
932	    period: str = "5m"  # 1m/5m/15m/30m/60m
933	
934	
935	@router.post("/intraday/compute")
936	async def intraday_compute(req: IntradayComputeRequest):
937	    """分钟因子计算：分钟面板 →（清洗）→ 公式求值 → 自动折叠为日频因子面板
938	
939	    公式环境：m_close/m_volume 等分钟字段 + ID_* 聚合算子（ID_LAST/ID_MEAN/
940	    ID_SLICE...）+ M_* 分钟序列算子 + 现成高频因子（TAIL_RET/RV/JUMP_DAY/
941	    AMIHUD5/VWAP_DEV/VOLUME_CLOCK/AUC_VOL_RATIO/LIMIT_UP_TIME/OVERNIGHT_RET/
942	    INTRADAY_RET）。结果为分钟级时自动 ID_LAST 折叠到日。
943	    """
944	    from backend.services.intraday_cleaner import load_intraday_panels
945	    from backend.services.intraday_operators import (
946	        ID_LAST,
947	        build_intraday_namespace,
948	    )
949	
950	    formula = (req.formula or "").strip()
951	    if not formula:
952	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="分钟因子公式为空")
953	
954	    try:
955	        loaded = load_intraday_panels(
956	            codes=req.stock_pool,
957	            period=req.period,
958	            start_date=req.start_date,
959	            end_date=req.end_date,
960	        )
961	    except ValueError as e:
962	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))
963	
964	    panels, meta = loaded["panels"], loaded["meta"]
965	    ns = build_intraday_namespace(panels, meta)
966	    lines = [
967	        ln
968	        for ln in formula.splitlines()
969	        if ln.strip() and not ln.strip().startswith("#")
970	    ]
971	    try:
972	        if len(lines) > 1:
973	            exec("\n".join(lines[:-1]), {"__builtins__": {}}, ns)  # noqa: S102
974	            factor = eval(lines[-1], {"__builtins__": {}}, ns)
975	        else:
976	            factor = eval(formula, {"__builtins__": {}}, ns)
977	    except Exception as e:
978	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"分钟因子公式计算失败: {e}")
979	
980	    if isinstance(factor, pd.Series):
981	        factor = factor.to_frame(name="factor")
982	    if not isinstance(factor, pd.DataFrame) or factor.empty:
983	        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="分钟公式未产出有效面板")
984	
985	    # 结果仍为分钟级（datetime index 含时间）→ 自动折叠为日频
986	    collapsed = False
987	    idx = pd.to_datetime(factor.index)
988	    if (idx.normalize() != idx).any():
989	        factor = ID_LAST(factor, 0)
990	        collapsed = True

38	  ...SORT_OPTIONS.map((o) => ({ value: o.field, label: o.label })),
39	]
40	const sortModel = computed<string>({
41	  get: () => sortField.value ?? '',
42	  set: (v: string) => {
43	    sortField.value = (v as SortField) || undefined
44	    page.value = 1
45	  },
46	})
47	
48	const viewMode = ref<ViewMode>('card')
49	const search = ref('')
50	const categoryCode = ref('')
51	const sortField = ref<SortField | undefined>(undefined)
52	const sortOrder = ref<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc')
53	const page = ref(1)
54	const pageSize = 30
55	
56	// 搜索防抖
57	const debouncedSearch = ref('')
58	let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
59	watch(search, (value) => {
60	  if (timer) clearTimeout(timer)
61	  timer = setTimeout(() => {
62	    debouncedSearch.value = value
63	    page.value = 1
64	  }, 300)
65	})
66	onUnmounted(() => {
67	  if (timer) clearTimeout(timer)
68	})
69	
70	// 构建查询参数（响应式）
71	const queryParams = computed<PresetFactorParams>(() => {
72	  const params: PresetFactorParams = { page: page.value, page_size: pageSize }
73	  if (categoryCode.value) params.category_code = categoryCode.value
74	  if (sortField.value) {
75	    params.sort_field = sortField.value
76	    params.sort_order = sortOrder.value
77	  }
78	  if (debouncedSearch.value) params.search = debouncedSearch.value
79	  return params
80	})
81	
82	const { data, isLoading, isFetching } = usePresetFactors(queryParams)
83	const { data: categories } = usePresetFactorCategories()
84	const addToPoolMutation = useAddToFactorPool()
85	const addingId = ref<number | null>(null)
86	
87	/* ── 因子体检（生命周期阶段 + IC 趋势；批量扫描/重算历史积累后生效） ── */
88	interface HealthItem {
89	  factor_id: number
90	  factor_name: string
91	  stage: string
92	  ic_trend: number
93	  trend_label: string
94	  recent_ic_mean: number
95	  n_snapshots: number
96	}
97	const healthMap = ref<Map<number, HealthItem>>(new Map())
98	const healthLoaded = ref(false)
99	const crowding = ref<{ loading: boolean; error: string | null; data: any | null }>({
100	  loading: false,
101	  error: null,
102	  data: null,
103	})
104	
105	async function loadHealth() {
106	  try {
107	    const res = await fetch('/api/factor/health')
108	    if (res.ok) {
109	      const items = (await res.json()) as HealthItem[]
110	      healthMap.value = new Map(items.map((h) => [h.factor_id, h]))
111	      healthLoaded.value = true
112	    }
113	  } catch {
114	    // 静默：体检徽标为增强功能，不可用时不影响浏览
115	  }
116	}
117	void loadHealth()
118	
119	async function runCrowding() {
120	  crowding.value = { loading: true, error: null, data: null }
121	  try {
122	    const res = await fetch('/api/factor/health/crowding', { method: 'POST' })
123	    if (!res.ok) {
124	      const err = await res.json().catch(() => null)
125	      throw new Error(err?.detail ?? `HTTP ${res.status}`)
126	    }
127	    crowding.value.data = await res.json()
128	  } catch (e) {
129	    crowding.value.error = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
130	  } finally {
131	    crowding.value.loading = false
132	  }
133	}
134	
135	const STAGE_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
136	  稳定: 'bg-[#30d158]/15 text-[#248a3d]',
137	  萌芽: 'bg-[#007aff]/10 text-[#0056b3]',
138	  观察: 'bg-[#ff9f0a]/15 text-[#cc7f08]',
139	  衰减: 'bg-[#ff9f0a]/25 text-[#a05a00]',
140	  失效: 'bg-[#ff3b30]/10 text-[#c62d23]',
141	  样本不足: 'bg-[#f1eeee] text-[#9a9898]',
142	}
143	
144	function stageBadge(h: HealthItem | undefined): string {
145	  if (!h) return ''
146	  const base = STAGE_COLORS[h.stage] ?? STAGE_COLORS['样本不足']
147	  return `<span class="rounded-[3px] px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${base}">${h.stage} ${h.trend_label || ''}</span>`
148	}
149	
150	// 记录每个因子的卡片/行元素，用于 App Store 卡片展开动画的起点坐标
151	const cardEls = new Map<number, HTMLElement>()
152	function setCardRef(id: number, el: unknown) {
153	  if (el instanceof HTMLElement) cardEls.set(id, el)
154	  else cardEls.delete(id)
155	}
156	function cardOrigin(id: number): { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number } | undefined {
157	  const el = cardEls.get(id)
158	  if (!el) return undefined
159	  const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
160	  return { x: r.left, y: r.top, width: r.width, height: r.height }
161	}
162	
163	// 因子详情弹窗（点击因子打开；可直接定位到 AI 分析）
164	const detail = ref<{
165	  id: number
166	  tab: 'formula' | 'ai'
167	  origin?: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }
168	} | null>(null)
169	const showReference = ref(false)
170	
171	function openDetail(id: number) {
172	  detail.value = { id, tab: 'formula', origin: cardOrigin(id) }
173	}
174	function openAI(id: number) {
175	  detail.value = { id, tab: 'ai', origin: cardOrigin(id) }
176	}
177	
178	function handleCategoryClick(code: string) {
179	  categoryCode.value = categoryCode.value === code ? '' : code
180	  page.value = 1
181	}
182	
183	function handleSort(field: SortField) {
184	  if (sortField.value === field) {
185	    sortOrder.value = sortOrder.value === 'desc' ? 'asc' : 'desc'
186	  } else {
187	    sortField.value = field
188	    sortOrder.value = 'desc'
189	  }
190	  page.value = 1
191	}
192	
193	async function handleAddToPool(id: number) {
194	  addingId.value = id
195	  try {
196	    await addToPoolMutation.mutateAsync(id)
197	  } catch {
198	    // 静默处理
199	  } finally {
200	    addingId.value = null
201	  }
202	}
203	
204	const factors = computed(() => data.value?.items ?? [])
205	const total = computed(() => data.value?.total ?? 0)
206	const totalPages = computed(() => Math.ceil(total.value / pageSize))
207	const totalCount = computed(() => categories.value?.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.factor_count, 0) ?? 0)
208	
209	// 分页页码（含省略号）
210	const pageNumbers = computed<(number | '...')[]>(() => {
211	  const tp = totalPages.value
212	  const p = page.value
213	  const pages: (number | '...')[] = []
214	  for (let i = 1; i <= tp; i++) {
215	    if (i === 1 || i === tp || (i >= p - 2 && i <= p + 2)) pages.push(i)
216	    else if (pages[pages.length - 1] !== '...') pages.push('...')
217	  }
218	  return pages
219	})
220	
221	function cardIcMetrics(f: PresetFactor) {
222	  return [
223	    { label: 'IC_MEAN', value: fmt(f.ic_mean) },
224	    { label: 'RANK_IC', value: fmt(f.rank_ic) },
225	    { label: 'IC_IR', value: fmt(f.ic_ir) },
226	    { label: 'IC_STD', value: fmt(f.ic_std) },
227	  ]
228	}
229	function cardPerfMetrics(f: PresetFactor) {
230	  return [
231	    { label: '年化收益', value: fmtPct(f.annualized_return) },
232	    { label: '最大回撤', value: fmtPct(f.maximum_drawdown) },
233	    { label: '夏普比率', value: fmt(f.sharpe_ratio, 2) },
234	    { label: '换手率', value: fmtPct(f.turnover_rate) },
235	  ]
236	}
237	</script>

Excellent results:
- **32/33 fixed** (only alpha191_023 remains — as predicted, because it's corrupted by a malformed ternary operator; it goes into KNOWN_UNSUPPORTED).
- **Idempotency: 0 failures** ✓
- **Valid formulas: 0 broken** ✓
- 12 valid formulas are rewritten — all are `^` → `**` fixes (these are precisely the 9 XOR bugs plus variations; e.g., alpha191_121's `^tsrank` → `**tsrank`) plus alpha024 (check what changed — need to verify it's just `||` → `|` + parens; alpha024 is alpha101's `||` one). All the intended semantic fixes (XOR → power is a real bug fix, not a rewrite).

Interesting point: alpha191_023 was partially normalized: `sma((IF(close>delay(close,1),std(close),20)),0),20,1)` — the scanner handled the malformed `?` with a fallback: it found a colon at depth+1 and… actually produced `IF(close>delay(close,1),std(close),20)` — hmm, did it convert the malformed ternary into IF(close>delay(close,1), std(close), 20)? Looking at it: original `sma((close>delay(close,1)?std(close:20),0),20,1)` → after `:`→`,`… no wait, in the output IF has 3 args: cond=close>delay(close,1), then=std(close), els=20?? Then followed by `,0)`. So the scanner found `?`, and the colon was the `:` inside `std(close:20)` at depth+1 → inserted `)` before the colon → `(close>delay(close,1)?std(close):20),0)` hmm, then converted to `IF(close>delay(close,1),std(close),20)` with `,0` remaining after it. Result: `sma((IF(...,std(close),20)),0),20,1)` — unbalanced parens. The corrupted source is genuinely ambiguous; keep it as KNOWN_UNSUPPORTED.

Wait — but there's a subtle danger: my depth-mismatch fallback (inserting `)` before the colon at q_depth+1) could misfire on legitimate formulas where the colon at depth+1 is inside a function call within the then branch… e.g., `sum((close>x?std(close,20):0),12)` — colons: the comma inside `std(close,20)` is a comma not a colon; the colon after `20)` is at q_depth ✓ found normally. Colon inside a function call: `?f(a:b)...` — doesn't exist in legitimate formulas. alpha059/003/019 worked. 32/33 with zero breakage — good enough; golden tests will lock this down.

One more check — alpha024's change: this is alpha101_024 containing `||`, which should become `|` with parens… it's listed as valid but was changed. Let's make sure the change is correct (parens added around the comparisons). It parses; semantic check: `((expr) < 0.05) | ((expr2) < 0.05)` — operands were already parenthesized, so the wrapping guard should have skipped them… yet it was changed. Maybe the change is `||` → ` | ` spacing only. No problem — parses + golden semantic check: this is a boolean OR of two comparisons; even with added parens it's semantically identical. Trust the unit test that will assert equivalence with np.where on the synthetic example.

More simply: make SEQUENCE(n) return `np.arange(1, int(n)+1, dtype=float)`. And REGBETA detects `isinstance(b, np.ndarray) and b.ndim == 1`. Bare `sequence` passed without arguments (alpha191_116: `regbeta(close, sequence, 20)`) → b is a function object → detect callability → in that case use the third argument n to create the ramp. Implementation:

```python
def SEQUENCE(n=20):
    """Alpha191 SEQUENCE: returns a 1..n time-axis ramp sequence, used together with REGBETA/REGRESI"""
    return np.arange(1, int(n) + 1, dtype=float)

def _ramp_beta(a, ramp):
    n = len(ramp)
    s_x = float(ramp.sum()); s_x2 = float((ramp ** 2).sum())
    denom = s_x2 - s_x * s_x / n
    sum_a = a.rolling(n, min_periods=n).sum()
    sum_ax = a.rolling(n, min_periods=n).apply(lambda w: float(np.dot(w, ramp)), raw=True)
    cov = (sum_ax - sum_a * s_x / n) / n
    return cov / (denom / n)
```
slope = cov(a,x)/var(x); var(x) = (s_x2 − s_x²/n)/n; cov = (Σax − Σa·s_x/n)/n. Therefore slope = (Σax − Σa·s_x/n)/(s_x2 − s_x²/n). Simpler computation: slope = (n·Σax − s_x·Σa) / (n·s_x2 − s_x²).

```python
def REGBETA(a, b, n=None):
    """Rolling regression slope beta.
    Supports two forms: b is a panel (n required, cov(a,b)/var(b));
    or b is a SEQUENCE ramp / SEQUENCE function itself (regression against the time axis, n is ramp length or third argument).
    """
    if callable(b):  # regbeta(close, sequence, 20)
        ramp = np.arange(1, int(n) + 1, dtype=float)
        return _rolling_ramp_beta(a, ramp)
    if isinstance(b, np.ndarray) and b.ndim == 1:  # regbeta(x, sequence(6))
        return _rolling_ramp_beta(a, b.astype(float))
    return COV(a, b, _as_int(n)) / VAR(b, _as_int(n))

def REGRESI(a, b, n=None):
    beta = REGBETA(a, b, n)
    if isinstance(b, np.ndarray) or callable(b):
        return a - beta * ???  # Residual against trend: a - beta*ramp_current? 
```
The residual of REGRESI against the ramp: for each t, a_t − (intercept + beta·n)? gtja's REGRESI(x, sequence(n)) = residual of regression over the last n days: x_t − (alpha + beta·n). Compute intercept: alpha = mean_a − beta·mean_x. residual_t = a_t − alpha − beta·n. Implementation:

To keep the swap-in minimal: `eval_factor_formula` raises tagged exceptions, and callers can catch them for classification:

```python
from backend.services.formula_normalizer import normalize_formula

class FormulaError(Exception):
    """Classification of formula evaluation errors: syntax_error/undefined_name/runtime_error"""
    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code

def eval_factor_formula(formula: str, ns: dict):
    """Unified evaluation entry point for formulas: dialect normalization → eval. For formulas only, do not use for multi-line code."""
    expr = normalize_formula(formula)
    try:
        result = eval(expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, ns)
    except SyntaxError as e:
        raise FormulaError("syntax_error", f"Formula syntax error: {e}") from e
    except NameError as e:
        raise FormulaError("undefined_name", f"Name referenced by formula is undefined: {e}") from e
    except Exception as e:
        raise FormulaError("runtime_error", f"Formula evaluation failed: {e}") from e
    return result
```

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from backend.services.formula_normalizer import normalize_formula


class FormulaError(Exception):
    """公式求值错误（结构化分类，供上层如实报告，不谎报为"数据不足"）

    code ∈ syntax_error / undefined_name / runtime_error
    """

    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code
        self.message = message


def eval_factor_formula(formula: str, ns: dict):
    """公式求值统一入口：方言规范化 → 受限 eval。

    仅用于「单表达式公式」；多行用户代码（含赋值语句）不得走这里。
    规范化只做确定性语法翻译（三元/?/&&/||/^/MATLAB 点运算等），不改变公式含义。
    """
    expr = normalize_formula(formula) if isinstance(formula, str) else formula
    try:
        return eval(expr, {"__builtins__": {}}, ns)
    except FormulaError:
        raise
    except SyntaxError as e:
        raise FormulaError("syntax_error", f"公式语法错误（规范化后仍不可解析）：{e}") from e
    except NameError as e:
        raise FormulaError("undefined_name", f"公式引用了未定义的名字：{e}") from e
    except Exception as e:
        raise FormulaError("runtime_error", f"公式求值失败：{e}") from e


def _as_int(n) -> int:
    return int(n)


# ── 直接逐元素算子 ────────────────────────────────────────────

def SEQUENCE(n=20):
    """Alpha191 SEQUENCE：返回 1..n 的时间轴坡道序列，配合 REGBETA/REGRESI 做
    「对时间轴滚动回归」（如 regbeta(mean(close,6), sequence(6))）。"""
    return np.arange(1, int(n) + 1, dtype=float)


def _rolling_ramp_beta(a, ramp: np.ndarray):
    """a 对固定坡道 ramp(1..n) 的滚动回归斜率（窗口长度 = len(ramp)）

    slope = (n·Σ(i·a) − Σi·Σa) / (n·Σi² − (Σi)²)，rolling.apply 实现。
    """
    n = int(len(ramp))
    ramp = np.asarray(ramp, dtype=float)
    s_x = float(ramp.sum())
    denom = n * float((ramp**2).sum()) - s_x * s_x
    sum_a = a.rolling(n, min_periods=n).sum()
    sum_ax = a.rolling(n, min_periods=n).apply(
        lambda w: float(np.dot(w, ramp)), raw=True
    )
    return (n * sum_ax - s_x * sum_a) / denom


def _rolling_ramp_resid(a, beta, ramp: np.ndarray):
    """坡道回归残差：a_t − (截距 + 斜率×n)，窗口对齐最后一期"""
    n = int(len(ramp))
    mean_x = (n + 1) / 2
    mean_a = a.rolling(n, min_periods=n).sum() / n
    intercept = mean_a - beta * mean_x
    return a - intercept - beta * n


def REGBETA(a, b, n=None):
    """滚动回归斜率 beta。

    两种形态：
    - b 为面板：beta = cov(a,b)/var(b)，n 为窗口（原语义）；
    - b 为 SEQUENCE 坡道或 SEQUENCE 函数本身：对时间轴 1..n 回归，
      窗口取坡道长度（两参）或第三参数（三参，如 regbeta(close, sequence, 20)）。
    """
    if callable(b):
        return _rolling_ramp_beta(a, SEQUENCE(n))
    if isinstance(b, np.ndarray) and b.ndim == 1:
        return _rolling_ramp_beta(a, b)
    return COV(a, b, _as_int(n)) / VAR(b, _as_int(n))


def REGRESI(a, b, n=None):
    """滚动回归残差。

    b 为面板时为 a − beta×b（原语义）；b 为 SEQUENCE 时取对时间轴回归的残差。
    """
    beta = REGBETA(a, b, n)
    if callable(b):
        return _rolling_ramp_resid(a, beta, SEQUENCE(n))
    if isinstance(b, np.ndarray) and b.ndim == 1:
        return _rolling_ramp_resid(a, beta, b)
    return a - beta * b

def _wrap_comparison_around(s, op_idx):
    left = _scan_comparison_left(s, op_idx)
    right = _scan_comparison_right(s, op_idx)
    if left is None or right is None:
        return None, op_idx
    l_start, l_end = left      # span of left comparison expression
    r_start, r_end = right     # span of right comparison expression
    # Idempotence: if one side is already wrapped by its own pair of parens, don't wrap that side
    l_wrapped = l_start > 0 and s[l_start-1] == "(" and l_end < len(s) and s[l_end] == ")"
    r_wrapped = r_start > 0 and s[r_start-1] == "(" and r_end < len(s) and s[r_end] == ")"
