840	# ── 风险画像 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
841	
842	
843	class RiskProfileRequest(BaseModel):
844	    code: str
845	    start_date: str = ""
846	    end_date: str = ""
847	    period: str = "1d"
848	
849	
850	@router.post("/risk-profile")
851	async def risk_profile(body: RiskProfileRequest):
852	    """单标的风险画像：收益/波动/回撤/尾部风险指标 + 净值与回撤曲线 + 收益分布"""
853	    s = _load_close(body.code, body.period)
854	    if s is None:
855	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
856	    s = _clip_range(s, body.start_date, body.end_date)
857	    if len(s) < 30:
858	        return {"error": "区间内样本不足 30 个交易日，无法给出有意义的风险指标"}
859	
860	    ret = s.pct_change().dropna()
861	    equity = (1 + ret).cumprod()
862	    roll_max = equity.cummax()
863	    drawdown = equity / roll_max - 1
864	
865	    n = len(ret)
866	    ann_ret = float((1 + ret.mean()) ** 250 - 1)
867	    ann_vol = float(ret.std() * np.sqrt(250))
868	    sharpe = ann_ret / ann_vol if ann_vol > 0 else 0.0
869	    max_dd = float(drawdown.min())
870	    var95 = float(ret.quantile(0.05))
871	    cvar95 = float(ret[ret <= var95].mean()) if (ret <= var95).any() else var95
872	
873	    metrics = {
874	        "区间涨跌幅": round(float(equity.iloc[-1] - 1) * 100, 2),
875	        "年化收益(%)": round(ann_ret * 100, 2),
876	        "年化波动(%)": round(ann_vol * 100, 2),
877	        "夏普比率": round(sharpe, 3),
878	        "最大回撤(%)": round(max_dd * 100, 2),
879	        "卡玛比率": round(ann_ret / abs(max_dd), 3) if max_dd < 0 else None,
880	        "日胜率(%)": round(float((ret > 0).mean()) * 100, 2),
881	        "偏度": round(float(ret.skew()), 3),
882	        "峰度": round(float(ret.kurt()), 3),
883	        "VaR95(日,%)": round(var95 * 100, 2),
884	        "CVaR95(日,%)": round(cvar95 * 100, 2),
885	        "样本数": n,
886	    }
887	
888	    dates = [str(d.date()) for d in equity.index]
889	    return {
890	        "code": body.code,
891	        "metrics": metrics,
892	        "equity": {"x": dates, "y": [round(float(v), 4) for v in equity]},
893	        "drawdown": {
894	            "x": dates,
895	            "y": [round(float(v) * 100, 2) for v in drawdown],
896	        },
897	        "return_hist": _histogram(ret * 100, bins=30),
898	    }
899

901	# ── 配对价差分析 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
902	
903	
904	class PairSpreadRequest(BaseModel):
905	    code_a: str
906	    code_b: str
907	    window: int = 60
908	    start_date: str = ""
909	    end_date: str = ""
910	    period: str = "1d"
911	
912	
913	@router.post("/pair-spread")
914	async def pair_spread(body: PairSpreadRequest):
915	    """配对价差：价格比价序列 + 对数价差滚动 Z-Score（±2 带），支持配对交易研究"""
916	    sa = _load_close(body.code_a, body.period)
917	    sb = _load_close(body.code_b, body.period)
918	    if sa is None:
919	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_a} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
920	    if sb is None:
921	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_b} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
922	
923	    df = pd.DataFrame({"a": sa, "b": sb}).dropna()
924	    df = df[(df["a"] > 0) & (df["b"] > 0)]
925	    window = max(int(body.window), 5)
926	    df = _clip_df_range(df, body.start_date, body.end_date, extra_head=window)
927	    if len(df) < window + 10:
928	        return {
929	            "error": f"重叠样本不足（需至少 {window + 10} 个交易日），调整区间或窗口"
930	        }
931	
932	    ratio = df["a"] / df["b"]
933	    log_spread = np.log(df["a"]) - np.log(df["b"])
934	    roll_mean = log_spread.rolling(window).mean()
935	    roll_std = log_spread.rolling(window).std()
936	    zscore = ((log_spread - roll_mean) / roll_std).dropna()
937	
938	    # 裁到用户请求区间（前面多取了 window 个热身样本）
939	    if body.start_date:
940	        zscore = zscore[zscore.index >= pd.to_datetime(body.start_date)]
941	        ratio = ratio[ratio.index >= pd.to_datetime(body.start_date)]
942	    if zscore.empty:
943	        return {"error": "所选区间内无有效 Z-Score 样本，请扩大区间"}
944	
945	    ret_corr = float(df["a"].pct_change().corr(df["b"].pct_change()))
946	    cur_z = float(zscore.iloc[-1])
947	    return {
948	        "code_a": body.code_a,
949	        "code_b": body.code_b,
950	        "window": window,
951	        "stats": {
952	            "当前 Z-Score": round(cur_z, 3),
953	            "收益相关系数": round(ret_corr, 3),
954	            "当前比价": round(float(ratio.iloc[-1]), 4),
955	            "比价均值": round(float(ratio.mean()), 4),
956	            "|Z|>2 占比(%)": round(float((zscore.abs() > 2).mean()) * 100, 2),
957	            "样本数": len(zscore),
958	        },
959	        "ratio": {
960	            "x": [str(d.date()) for d in ratio.index],
961	            "y": [round(float(v), 4) for v in ratio],
962	        },
963	        "zscore": {
964	            "x": [str(d.date()) for d in zscore.index],
965	            "y": [round(float(v), 3) for v in zscore],
966	        },
967	    }
968	
969	
970	def _clip_df_range(
971	    df: pd.DataFrame, start_date: str, end_date: str, extra_head: int = 0
972	) -> pd.DataFrame:
973	    """按区间裁剪 DataFrame，可在起点前多保留 extra_head 行供滚动窗口热身"""
974	    if end_date:
975	        df = df[df.index <= pd.to_datetime(end_date)]
976	    if start_date:
977	        start = pd.to_datetime(start_date)
978	        pos = df.index.searchsorted(start)
979	        df = df.iloc[max(0, int(pos) - extra_head) :]
980	    return df
981

996	async def rolling_corr(body: RollingCorrRequest):

999	    sb = _load_close(body.code_b, body.period)

1	"""数据探索服务 — 使用 DuckDB 查询本地 Parquet 数据"""
2	import math
3	
4	import duckdb
5	import pandas as pd
6	from loguru import logger
7	
8	from backend.config import settings
9	
10	
11	class DataExplorerService:
12	    """数据探索服务"""
13	    
14	    def __init__(self):
15	        self.cache_dir = settings.cache_dir
16	    
17	    def query(self, sql: str, params: list | None = None) -> dict:
18	        """执行 SQL 查询本地 Parquet 数据"""
19	        try:
20	            conn = duckdb.connect()
21	            if params:
22	                result = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchdf()
23	            else:
24	                result = conn.execute(sql).fetchdf()
25	            conn.close()
26	            
27	            columns = result.columns.tolist()
28	            data = []
29	            for row in result.values.tolist():
30	                clean_row = []
31	                for val in row:
32	                    if isinstance(val, float) and math.isnan(val):
33	                        clean_row.append(None)
34	                    elif isinstance(val, pd.Timestamp):
35	                        clean_row.append(str(val))
36	                    else:
37	                        clean_row.append(val)
38	                data.append(clean_row)
39	            
40	            return {"columns": columns, "data": data, "row_count": len(data)}
41	        except Exception as e:
42	            logger.error(f"Query failed: {e}")
43	            return {"columns": [], "data": [], "row_count": 0, "error": str(e)}
44	    
45	    def market_scan(self, date: str, conditions: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
46	        """全市场扫描"""
47	        cache_pattern = str(self.cache_dir / "1d" / "*.parquet")
48	        where_parts = [f"CAST(index AS VARCHAR) LIKE '{date}%'"]
49	        if conditions:
50	            where_parts.extend(conditions)
51	        where_clause = " AND ".join(where_parts)
52	        sql = f"SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{cache_pattern}') WHERE {where_clause}"
53	        return self.query(sql)
54	    
55	    def cross_section_analysis(self, date: str, field: str, codes: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
56	        """横截面分析"""
57	        cache_pattern = str(self.cache_dir / "1d" / "*.parquet")
58	        where_parts = [f"CAST(index AS VARCHAR) LIKE '{date}%'"]
59	        if codes:
60	            code_list = "', '".join(c.replace(".", "_") for c in codes)
61	            where_parts.append(f"filename IN ('{code_list}')")
62	        where_clause = " AND ".join(where_parts)
63	        
64	        stats_sql = f"""
65	            SELECT COUNT(*) as count, AVG({field}) as mean, MIN({field}) as min,
66	                   MAX({field}) as max, STDDEV({field}) as stddev,
67	                   APPROX_QUANTILE({field}, 0.25) as q25,
68	                   APPROX_QUANTILE({field}, 0.5) as median,
69	                   APPROX_QUANTILE({field}, 0.75) as q75
70	            FROM read_parquet('{cache_pattern}') WHERE {where_clause}
71	        """
72	        stats = self.query(stats_sql)
73	        return {"statistics": stats}
74	    
75	    def anomaly_detection(self, code: str, field: str, window: int = 20, threshold: float = 2.0) -> dict:
76	        """异常值检测（滚动 Z-Score）"""
77	        safe_code = code.replace(".", "_")
78	        file_path = self.cache_dir / "1d" / f"{safe_code}.parquet"
79	        if not file_path.exists():
80	            return {"anomalies": [], "error": f"数据文件不存在: {file_path}"}
81	        
82	        sql = f"""
83	            WITH data AS (
84	                SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () as rn FROM read_parquet('{file_path}')
85	            ),
86	            stats AS (
87	                SELECT *, 
88	                    AVG({field}) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN {window} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_mean,
89	                    STDDEV({field}) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN {window} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_std
90	                FROM data
91	            )
92	            SELECT *, ABS({field} - rolling_mean) / NULLIF(rolling_std, 0) as z_score
93	            FROM stats
94	            WHERE ABS({field} - rolling_mean) / NULLIF(rolling_std, 0) > {threshold}
95	        """
96	        result = self.query(sql)
97	        return {"anomalies": result, "code": code, "field": field}
98	    
99	    def data_quality_check(self, codes: list[str], period: str = "1d") -> dict:
100	        """数据质量检查"""
101	        report = {"total_codes": len(codes), "checked_codes": 0, "issues": []}
102	        for code in codes:
103	            safe_code = code.replace(".", "_")
104	            file_path = self.cache_dir / period / f"{safe_code}.parquet"
105	            if not file_path.exists():
106	                report["issues"].append({"code": code, "issue": "missing_file", "message": "缓存文件不存在"})
107	                continue
108	            report["checked_codes"] += 1
109	            sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(*) - COUNT(close) as null_close FROM read_parquet('{file_path}')"
110	            result = self.query(sql)
111	            if result["data"]:
112	                total, null_close = result["data"][0]
113	                if null_close and null_close > 0:
114	                    report["issues"].append({"code": code, "issue": "null_values", "message": f"close 有 {null_close} 个空值"})
115	                if total == 0:
116	                    report["issues"].append({"code": code, "issue": "empty_data", "message": "数据为空"})
117	        report["summary"] = {"total_issues": len(report["issues"])}
118	        return report
119	
120	
121	# 全局单例
122	data_explorer = DataExplorerService()

1	"""DuckDB 服务 — 使用 SQL 查询本地 Parquet 数据"""
2	from __future__ import annotations
3	
4	import math
5	import re
6	
7	import duckdb
8	import pandas as pd
9	from loguru import logger
10	
11	from backend.config import settings
12	
13	# 单次查询返回的最大结果行数（防止整市场扫描 OOM）
14	MAX_RESULT_ROWS = 2000
15	
16	# 写/危险操作关键字，禁止在本地查询接口中出现（读接口只允许查询）
17	_SQL_FORBIDDEN = re.compile(
18	    r"\b(insert|update|delete|drop|create|alter|attach|detach|"
19	    r"export|copy|import|install|load|pragma|call)\b",
20	    re.IGNORECASE,
21	)
22	
23	
24	class DuckDBService:
25	    """DuckDB 查询服务，提供对本地 Parquet 缓存的 SQL 访问"""
26	
27	    def __init__(self):
28	        self.cache_dir = settings.cache_dir
29	
30	    # ── 核心查询 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
31	
32	    def query_local(self, sql: str, params: list | None = None) -> dict:
33	        """执行 SQL 查询本地 Parquet 数据
34	
35	        支持语法：
36	            SELECT * FROM read_parquet('data/cache/1d/*.parquet') WHERE ...
37	            SELECT * FROM 'data/cache/1d/000001_SZ.parquet' WHERE ...
38	
39	        Args:
40	            sql: SQL 查询语句
41	            params: 查询参数
42	
43	        Returns:
44	            {"columns": [...], "data": [...], "row_count": N}
45	        """
46	        try:
47	            statement = sql.lstrip().lstrip("(").lower()
48	            if not statement.startswith(("select", "with", "describe", "show")):
49	                return {
50	                    "columns": [],
51	                    "data": [],
52	                    "row_count": 0,
53	                    "error": "仅支持 SELECT / WITH / DESCRIBE 查询",
54	                }
55	            if _SQL_FORBIDDEN.search(sql):
56	                return {
57	                    "columns": [],
58	                    "data": [],
59	                    "row_count": 0,
60	                    "error": "SQL 中包含不允许的写操作关键字",
61	                }
62	
63	            conn = duckdb.connect()
64	            if params:
65	                result = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchdf()
66	            else:
67	                result = conn.execute(sql).fetchdf()
68	            conn.close()
69	
70	            truncated = len(result) > MAX_RESULT_ROWS
71	            if truncated:
72	                result = result.iloc[:MAX_RESULT_ROWS]
73	
74	            columns = result.columns.tolist()
75	            data = result.values.tolist()
76	
77	            # 清理 NaN / Timestamp 等不可序列化类型
78	            clean_data = []
79	            for row in data:
80	                clean_row = []
81	                for val in row:
82	                    if isinstance(val, float) and math.isnan(val):
83	                        clean_row.append(None)
84	                    elif isinstance(val, pd.Timestamp):
85	                        clean_row.append(str(val))
86	                    else:
87	                        clean_row.append(val)
88	                clean_data.append(clean_row)
89	
90	            return {
91	                "columns": columns,
92	                "data": clean_data,
93	                "row_count": len(clean_data),
94	                "truncated": truncated if truncated else False,
95	            }
96	        except Exception as e:
97	            logger.error(f"DuckDB query failed: {e}")
98	            return {"columns": [], "data": [], "row_count": 0, "error": str(e)}
99	
100	    # ── 路径工具 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
101	
102	    def get_parquet_path(self, code: str, period: str = "1d") -> str:
103	        """获取 Parquet 文件路径字符串（可直接用于 SQL）
104	
105	        Args:
106	            code: 股票代码（如 "000001.SZ"，内部将 '.' 替换为 '_'）
107	            period: 数据周期
108	
109	        Returns:
110	            绝对路径字符串
111	        """
112	        safe_code = code.replace(".", "_")
113	        return str(self.cache_dir / period / f"{safe_code}.parquet")
114

33	def _ensure_http_scheme(base_url: str, label: str) -> None:
34	    """仅允许 http(s) 端点，防止把用户 API Key 发往 file:// / 内网任意主机"""
35	    scheme = urllib.parse.urlsplit(base_url).scheme.lower()
36	    if scheme not in ("http", "https"):
37	        raise HTTPException(
38	            status_code=400, detail=f"{label} 仅支持 http/https 协议"
39	        )

42	def _resolve_ai_config() -> tuple[str, str, str]:
43	    """解析当前生效的 (base_url, api_key, model)，未配置时抛 400
44	
45	    预置供应商直接用注册表里的 Base URL；仅 custom（BYOK）读用户自填。
46	    """
47	    if not settings.openai_api_key:
48	        raise HTTPException(
49	            status_code=400, detail="未配置 AI API Key，请到「设置 → AI 配置」中填写"
50	        )
51	    provider = resolve_provider(settings.ai_provider)
52	    preset = PROVIDER_PRESETS[provider]
53	    if provider == "custom":
54	        base_url = (settings.openai_base_url or "").rstrip("/")
55	    else:
56	        base_url = preset["base_url"].rstrip("/")
57	    model = settings.ai_model or preset["model"]
58	    if not base_url:
59	        raise HTTPException(
60	            status_code=400, detail="未配置 AI Base URL，请到「设置 → AI 配置」中填写"
61	        )
62	    if not model:
63	        raise HTTPException(
64	            status_code=400, detail="未配置 AI 模型名称，请到「设置 → AI 配置」中填写"
65	        )
66	    _ensure_http_scheme(base_url, "AI Base URL")
67	    return base_url, settings.openai_api_key, model

126	def _strip_code_fence(text: str) -> str:
127	    """去掉 AI 可能包裹的 markdown 代码块围栏"""
128	    text = text.strip()
129	    m = re.match(r"^```[a-zA-Z0-9]*\n([\s\S]*?)\n?```$", text)
130	    return m.group(1) if m else text

137	NODE_CODE_SYSTEM = """你是 LocalQuant 量化投研平台的工作流节点开发专家。用户会提供一个节点的完整 Python 源码和修改要求，你需要输出修改后的完整源码。

139	## 节点代码结构（务必遵守）
140	一个节点文件由三部分组成：
141	1. **输入模型**：Pydantic BaseModel，定义节点的输入参数。可用 @ui(...) 装饰器为字段指定前端控件：
142	   - date_picker（日期）/ text_field（文本）/ code_editor（代码）/ combobox（下拉，配 options）/ number_field（数字）
143	   - {"input_type": "None"} 表示该字段仅通过上游节点连线输入，不渲染控件
144	   - DataFrame 类型字段需要 model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)
145	2. **输出模型**：Pydantic BaseModel，定义输出字段（下游节点通过连线消费这些字段）
146	3. **节点类**：用 @work_node(name=显示名, group=分组, box_color=颜色, description=描述) 装饰、继承 BaseWorkNode，实现三个方法：
147	   - input_model() / output_model()：返回上述两个 Model 类
148	   - run(self, input)：节点计算逻辑，返回输出模型实例
149	
150	## 修改规则
151	- 只修改与用户要求相关的代码，其余部分原样保留（包括注释与空行）
152	- 不要改动 @work_node 装饰的节点类的类名（系统依赖类名识别节点来源）
153	- 需要新参数时：加到输入模型并配好 @ui 控件类型；需要新输出时：加到输出模型并在 run() 中赋值
154	- 保持所有 import 完整，代码必须可直接运行
155	- 输出字典/曲线类结果时保持 JSON 可序列化（键转 str、值转 float）
156	
157	## 输出格式
158	只输出修改后的完整 Python 源码。不要输出任何解释、说明或 markdown 代码块围栏。"""

189	{node_catalog}
190	
191	## 输出 JSON 格式（严格遵守）
192	{{
193	  "name": "工作流名称",
194	  "nodes": [
195	    {{"uuid": "n1", "name": "节点类名", "title": "节点显示标题", "positionX": 80, "positionY": 120, "static_input_data": {{"参数名": "参数值"}}}}
196	  ],
197	  "links": [
198	    {{"uuid": "l1", "previous_node_uuid": "n1", "output_field_name": "上游输出字段名", "next_node_uuid": "n2", "input_field_name": "下游输入字段名"}}
199	  ]
200	}}
201	
202	## 编排规则
203	- nodes[].name 必须是节点目录中存在的类名；static_input_data 的键必须是该节点输入字段名
204	- 连线的 output_field_name / input_field_name 必须分别是上游输出字段和下游输入字段，且类型语义匹配（如 DataFrame 接 DataFrame）
205	- 标注为「仅连线输入」的字段必须通过 links 提供，不要放进 static_input_data
206	- 布局：从左到右按执行顺序排列，positionX 每列间隔约 300，positionY 分支间隔约 220
207	- 工作流必须是无环 DAG
208	- 只输出 JSON，不要输出任何解释文字或 markdown 代码块围栏。"""
209	
210	
211	def _build_node_catalog() -> str:
212	    """把注册表节点压缩成给 AI 的目录文本"""
213	    from backend.plugins.registry import ALL_WORK_NODES
214	
215	    lines: list[str] = []
216	    for cls in ALL_WORK_NODES.values():
217	        try:
218	            schema = cls().get_schema()
219	        except Exception:
220	            continue
221	        inputs = []
222	        for key, prop in (
223	            (schema.get("input_schema") or {}).get("properties", {}).items()
224	        ):
225	            ui_type = (prop.get("ui") or {}).get("input_type", "text_field")
226	            mark = "仅连线输入" if ui_type == "None" else ui_type
227	            default = prop.get("default")
228	            default_str = f", 默认={default!r}" if default not in (None, "") else ""
229	            inputs.append(f"{key}({mark}{default_str})")
230	        outputs = list(
231	            ((schema.get("output_schema") or {}).get("properties", {})).keys()
232	        )
233	        lines.append(
234	            f"- {schema['name']}（{schema['display_name']}，{schema['group']}）"
235	            f" 输入: {', '.join(inputs) or '无'} | 输出: {', '.join(outputs) or '无'}"
236	        )
237	    return "\n".join(lines)

317	FACTOR_ADVICE_SYSTEM = """你是量化因子研究专家。用户会提供一个选股因子的名称、公式、回测指标，以及（可选）walk-forward 样本外验证结果，请给出专业、简洁的分析与建议。
318	
319	输出要求（Markdown，中文，控制在 450 字以内）：
320	## 因子逻辑解读
321	用通俗语言解释公式在捕捉什么市场现象（动量/反转/量价背离等）
322	## 指标评价
323	逐项点评 IC 均值、ICIR、年化收益、回撤、换手率的强弱（给出行业经验参考区间）
324	## 样本外验证（若提供了验证数据）
325	点评 OOS IC 是否显著（|t| ≥ 2 才可信）、与 in-sample 的同向一致性（≥50% 为稳定）、OOS 多空累计与 IC 衰减速度；明确指出「因子在样本外是否仍然有效」这一核心结论
326	## 使用建议
327	适合的使用场景（单因子/多因子合成/中性化后使用）、适合的调仓周期、风险提示
328	
329	只基于给定数据分析，缺失的指标说明数据不足即可，不要编造数值。"""
330	
331	
332	class FactorAdviceRequest(BaseModel):
333	    factor_name: str
334	    factor_code: str | None = None
335	    formula: str | None = None
336	    description: str | None = None
337	    metrics: dict[str, Any] = {}
338	    validation: dict[str, Any] | None = None  # walk-forward 样本外验证结果（可选）
339	
340	
341	def _format_validation(validation: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
342	    """把 walk-forward 验证结果压缩成供 LLM 阅读的文本（缺失则返回空串）"""
343	    agg = validation.get("aggregate") if isinstance(validation, dict) else None
344	    folds = validation.get("folds") if isinstance(validation, dict) else []
345	    if not agg:
346	        return ""
347	    lines = [
348	        "样本外验证（walk-forward，train/test 滚动锚定分割）：",
349	        f"- 分割：训练 {validation.get('train_days', '?')} 日 / 测试 {validation.get('test_days', '?')} 日 / {validation.get('n_splits', '?')} 折，IC 周期 p={validation.get('period', 1)}",
350	        f"- OOS IC 均值: {agg.get('oos_ic_mean')}（t 值 {agg.get('oos_ic_tstat')}，|t|≥2 才显著）",
351	        f"- OOS ICIR: {agg.get('oos_ic_ir')}；in-sample 与 OOS 同向一致性: {agg.get('oos_sign_consistency')}",
352	        f"- OOS 多空累计: {agg.get('oos_long_short_total')}（均值每折 {agg.get('oos_long_short_mean_fold')}）",
353	        "- 测试段 IC 衰减: " + " / ".join(
354	            f"p{d['period']}={d['ic']}" for d in agg.get("ic_decay_oos", [])
355	        ),
356	    ]
357	    if folds:
358	        for fd in folds[:6]:
359	            lines.append(
360	                f"- 第{fd['fold']}折: 训练截止 {fd['train_end']} · 测试 {fd['test_start']}~{fd['test_end']} | "
361	                f"IS IC {fd['in_sample']['ic_mean']:.4f} (t {fd['in_sample']['t_stat']:.2f}) | "
362	                f"OOS IC {fd['out_of_sample']['ic_mean']:.4f} (t {fd['out_of_sample']['t_stat']:.2f}) | "
363	                f"多空累计 {fd['long_short_cum']:.2%}"
364	            )
365	    return "\n".join(lines)

1	"""Parquet 本地缓存管理
2	
3	存储结构: data/cache/{period}/{code}.parquet
4	支持增量追加、去重合并、缓存统计。
5	"""
6	from __future__ import annotations
7	
8	from pathlib import Path
9	
10	import pandas as pd
11	from loguru import logger
12	
13	from backend.config import settings
14	
15	
16	class DataCache:
17	    """基于 Parquet 的本地数据缓存"""
18	
19	    def __init__(self, cache_dir: Path | None = None):
20	        self._cache_dir = cache_dir or settings.cache_dir
21	        self._cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
22	
23	    # ── 路径 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
24	
25	    def _get_path(self, code: str, period: str) -> Path:
26	        """获取缓存文件路径（code 中 '.' 替换为 '_'）"""
27	        safe_code = code.replace(".", "_")
28	        period_dir = self._cache_dir / period
29	        period_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
30	        return period_dir / f"{safe_code}.parquet"
31	
32	    # ── 读取 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
33	
34	    def get(self, code: str, period: str) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
35	        """读取缓存数据，不存在则返回 None"""
36	        path = self._get_path(code, period)
37	        if not path.exists():
38	            return None
39	        try:
40	            df = pd.read_parquet(path)
41	            return df
42	        except Exception as e:
43	            logger.warning(f"Failed to read cache {path}: {e}")
44	            return None
45	
46	    # ── 写入 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
47	
48	    def save(self, code: str, period: str, df: pd.DataFrame):
49	        """保存 DataFrame 到 Parquet 缓存"""
50	        if df.empty:
51	            return
52	        path = self._get_path(code, period)
53	        try:
54	            df.to_parquet(path, engine="pyarrow", index=True)
55	            logger.debug(f"Cache saved: {path} ({len(df)} rows)")
56	        except Exception as e:
57	            logger.warning(f"Failed to save cache {path}: {e}")
58	
59	    # ── 增量更新 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
60	
61	    def get_or_append(self, code: str, period: str, new_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
62	        """增量更新：合并新数据并去重
63	
64	        如果已有缓存，合并后按索引去重（保留最新）；
65	        如果无缓存，直接保存新数据。
66	        """
67	        if new_df.empty:
68	            existing = self.get(code, period)
69	            return existing if existing is not None else pd.DataFrame()
70	
71	        existing = self.get(code, period)
72	        if existing is None:
73	            self.save(code, period, new_df)
74	            return new_df.copy()
75	
76	        # 合并并按索引去重（保留后面的新数据）
77	        combined = pd.concat([existing, new_df])
78	        combined = combined[~combined.index.duplicated(keep="last")]
79	        combined = combined.sort_index()
80	        self.save(code, period, combined)
81	        return combined.copy()
82	
83	    # ── 查询 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
84	
85	    def get_latest_timestamp(self, code: str, period: str) -> str | None:
86	        """获取缓存中最新一条数据的时间戳（字符串形式）"""
87	        df = self.get(code, period)
88	        if df is None or df.empty:
89	            return None
90	        try:
91	            latest = df.index[-1]
92	            return str(latest)
93	        except Exception:
94	            return None
95	
96	    # ── 失效 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
97	
98	    def invalidate(self, code: str, period: str):
99	        """删除指定缓存文件"""
100	        path = self._get_path(code, period)
101	        if path.exists():
102	            try:
103	                path.unlink()
104	                logger.info(f"Cache invalidated: {path}")
105	            except Exception as e:
106	                logger.warning(f"Failed to invalidate cache {path}: {e}")
107	
108	    # ── 统计 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
109	
110	    def cache_status(self) -> dict:
111	        """统计缓存状态：文件数、总大小、按周期分组"""
112	        total_files = 0
113	        total_size = 0
114	        by_period: dict[str, dict] = {}
115	
116	        if not self._cache_dir.exists():
117	            return {"total_files": 0, "total_size_bytes": 0, "by_period": {}}
118	
119	        for period_dir in sorted(self._cache_dir.iterdir()):
120	            if not period_dir.is_dir():
121	                continue
122	            period_name = period_dir.name
123	            files = list(period_dir.glob("*.parquet"))
124	            if not files:
125	                continue
126	            dir_size = sum(f.stat().st_size for f in files if f.exists())
127	            by_period[period_name] = {
128	                "files": len(files),
129	                "size_bytes": dir_size,
130	            }
131	            total_files += len(files)
132	            total_size += dir_size
133	
134	        return {
135	            "total_files": total_files,
136	            "total_size_bytes": total_size,
137	            "by_period": by_period,
138	        }

12	def conv_time(timestamp_ms: float) -> str:
13	    """毫秒时间戳转 "20240101150000" 格式字符串
14	
15	    Args:
16	        timestamp_ms: 毫秒级时间戳

25	def normalize_timestamp(index: pd.Index) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
26	    """将各种时间索引统一转为 Asia/Shanghai 无时区 DatetimeIndex。
27	
28	    QMT 行情时间戳均为北京时间；epoch 毫秒/秒若按 UTC 解释会让分钟 bar
29	    产生 8 小时时移。统一转到 Asia/Shanghai 后再丢弃时区，避免下游
30	    再做 tz_localize(None) 时保留错误时刻。
31	    """
32	    if isinstance(index, pd.DatetimeIndex):
33	        if index.tz is not None:
34	            return index.tz_convert("Asia/Shanghai").tz_localize(None)
35	        return index
36	
37	    # 整数/浮点索引 → epoch 时间戳；按量级区分毫秒/秒
38	    if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(index) or pd.api.types.is_float_dtype(index):
39	        values = pd.Series(pd.to_numeric(index, errors="coerce")).dropna()
40	        max_abs = float(values.abs().max()) if len(values) else 0.0
41	        unit = "ms" if max_abs > 1e11 else "s"
42	        return (
43	            pd.to_datetime(index.astype("int64"), unit=unit, utc=True)
44	            .tz_convert("Asia/Shanghai")
45	            .tz_localize(None)
46	        )
47	
48	    # 字符串或其他 → 尝试解析（字符串由 QMT 给出时通常已是北京时间）
49	    return pd.to_datetime(index)

73	    }

119	def df_to_serializable(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
120	    """将 DataFrame 转为 JSON 可序列化格式
121	
122	    Returns:
123	        {"columns": [...], "index": [...], "data": [[...], ...]}
124	    """
125	    if df.empty:

127

132	            index_values.append(v.isoformat())
133	        else:
134	            index_values.append(str(v))
135	
136	    # 处理数据（NaN → None）
137	    data = []
138	    for row in df.itertuples(index=False):
139	        data.append([
140	            None if (isinstance(v, float) and pd.isna(v)) else v
141	            for v in row
142	        ])
143	
144	    return {
145	        "columns": list(df.columns),
146	        "index": index_values,
147	        "data": data,
148	    }

308	            # 行情周期：用覆盖度缓存的并集范围；列结构只读第一个文件即可（下载层保证同构）
309	            sample = _load_stock(files[0])
310	            columns = list(sample.columns) if sample is not None else []
311	            date_range = ""
312	            try:
313	                coverage = market_data.cache_coverage(period_dir.name)
314	                starts = [e.get("start") for e in coverage if e.get("start")]
315	                ends = [e.get("end") for e in coverage if e.get("end")]
316	                if starts and ends:
317	                    date_range = f"{min(starts)} ~ {max(ends)}"
318	            except Exception:
319	                if sample is not None and len(sample) > 0:
320	                    date_range = f"{sample.index.min().date()} ~ {sample.index.max().date()}"
321	            all_codes = [_file_code(f) for f in files]
322	            tables.append(
323	                {
324	                    "period": period_dir.name,
325	                    "path": f"data/cache/{period_dir.name}/*.parquet",
326	                    "kind": "quotes",
327	                    "stock_count": len(files),
328	                    "columns": columns,
329	                    "sample_range": date_range,
330	                    "codes": all_codes[:200],
331	                    "codes_truncated": len(all_codes) > 200,
332	                    "note": (
333	                        "缓存为不复权价 + adjust_factor 列；前复权价 = close × adjust_factor / 最新 adjust_factor"
334	                        if "adjust_factor" in columns
335	                        else "旧版前复权缓存（无 adjust_factor 列）"
336	                    ),
337	                }
338	            )
339	    return {"tables": tables}

342	# ── 全市场扫描 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
343	
344	_COND_RE = re.compile(
345	    r"^\s*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*(>=|<=|>|<|==|!=|=)\s*(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*$"
346	)
347	
348	
349	class ScanRequest(BaseModel):
350	    date: str
351	    conditions: list[str] = []
352	    period: str = "1d"
353	
354	
355	@router.post("/scan")
356	async def market_scan(body: ScanRequest):
357	    """按日期对全部缓存股票做条件扫描（如 close > 10; volume > 1000000）"""
358	    files = _cache_files(body.period)
359	    if not files:
360	        err = market_data.no_cache_error_detail(body.period)
361	        return {
362	            "columns": [],
363	            "data": [],
364	            "row_count": 0,
365	            "error": err["message"] + " — " + err["hint"],
366	            "code": err["code"],
367	        }
368	
369	    parsed = []
370	    for cond in body.conditions:
371	        m = _COND_RE.match(cond)
372	        if not m:
373	            return {
374	                "columns": [],
375	                "data": [],
376	                "row_count": 0,
377	                "error": f"条件格式不支持: {cond}（示例: close > 10）",
378	                "code": "invalid_request",
379	            }
380	        col, op, val = m.group(1), m.group(2), float(m.group(3))
381	        parsed.append((col, "==" if op == "=" else op, val))
382	
383	    try:
384	        target = pd.to_datetime(body.date)
385	    except Exception:
386	        return {
387	            "columns": [],
388	            "data": [],
389	            "row_count": 0,
390	            "error": "日期格式不合法",
391	            "code": "invalid_request",
392	        }
393	
394	    rows = []
395	    columns: list[str] = []
396	    for path in files:
397	        df = _load_stock(path)
398	        if df is None or df.empty:
399	            continue
400	        day = df[df.index.normalize() == target.normalize()]
401	        if day.empty:
402	            continue
403	        rec = day.iloc[-1]
404	        ok = True
405	        for col, op, val in parsed:
406	            if col not in rec.index:
407	                ok = False
408	                break
409	            v = rec[col]
410	            if pd.isna(v):
411	                ok = False
412	                break
413	            if (
414	                (op == ">" and v <= val)
415	                or (op == "<" and v >= val)
416	                or (op == ">=" and v < val)
417	                or (op == "<=" and v > val)
418	                or (op == "==" and v != val)
419	                or (op == "!=" and v == val)
420	            ):
421	                ok = False
422	            if not ok:
423	                break
424	        if ok:
425	            if not columns:
426	                columns = ["code"] + list(rec.index)
427	            rows.append([_file_code(path)] + [_clean_value(v) for v in rec.tolist()])
428	
429	    return {"columns": columns, "data": rows, "row_count": len(rows)}
430

492	    ]

500	# ── 异常检测 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
501	
502	
503	class AnomalyRequest(BaseModel):
504	    code: str
505	    field: str = "close"
506	    window: int = 20
507	    threshold: float = 2.0
508	    period: str = "1d"
509	
510	
511	@router.post("/anomaly")
512	async def anomaly_detection(body: AnomalyRequest):
513	    """滚动 Z-Score 异常检测：|值 - 滚动均值| > threshold × 滚动标准差"""
514	    safe_code = body.code.strip().replace(".", "_")
515	    path = settings.cache_dir / body.period / f"{safe_code}.parquet"
516	    if not path.exists():
517	        return {
518	            "error": f"未找到 {body.code} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载",
519	            "code": "no_cached_data",
520	        }
521	
522	    df = _load_stock(path)
523	    if df is None or df.empty or body.field not in df.columns:
524	        return {"error": f"数据为空或缺少字段 {body.field}", "code": "invalid_field"}
525	
526	    s = df[body.field].astype(float)
527	    window = max(int(body.window), 2)
528	    rolling_mean = s.rolling(window).mean()
529	    rolling_std = s.rolling(window).std()
530	    zscore = (s - rolling_mean) / rolling_std
531	    mask = zscore.abs() > body.threshold
532	
533	    columns = ["date", body.field, "rolling_mean", "zscore", "direction"]
534	    rows = []
535	    for idx in s.index[mask.fillna(False)]:
536	        z = float(zscore.loc[idx])
537	        rows.append(
538	            [
539	                str(idx.date()),
540	                _clean_value(s.loc[idx]),
541	                _clean_value(rolling_mean.loc[idx]),
542	                round(z, 3),
543	                "偏高" if z > 0 else "偏低",
544	            ]
545	        )
546	
547	    return {
548	        "anomalies": {"columns": columns, "data": rows, "row_count": len(rows)},
549	        "code": body.code,
550	        "field": body.field,
551	    }
552

554	# ── 公共：按代码加载收盘价序列 ─────────────────────────────
555	
556	
557	def _load_close(code: str, period: str = "1d") -> pd.Series | None:
558	    """加载单只股票的收盘价序列（本地缓存），不存在返回 None"""
559	    safe_code = code.strip().replace(".", "_")
560	    path = settings.cache_dir / period / f"{safe_code}.parquet"
561	    if not path.exists():
562	        return None
563	    df = _load_stock(path)
564	    if df is None or df.empty or "close" not in df.columns:
565	        return None
566	    s = df["close"].astype(float).dropna()
567	    s.index = pd.to_datetime(s.index).normalize()
568	    return s[~s.index.duplicated(keep="last")].sort_index()
569	
570	
571	def _clip_range(s: pd.Series, start_date: str, end_date: str) -> pd.Series:
572	    if start_date:
573	        s = s[s.index >= pd.to_datetime(start_date)]
574	    if end_date:
575	        s = s[s.index <= pd.to_datetime(end_date)]
576	    return s
577	
578	
579	def _histogram(values: pd.Series, bins: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
580	    counts, edges = np.histogram(values.dropna(), bins=bins)
581	    return [
582	        {"bin": f"{edges[i]:.4g}", "count": int(counts[i])} for i in range(len(counts))
583	    ]

586	# ── 回归分析 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
587	
588	
589	class RegressionRequest(BaseModel):
590	    code_y: str  # 因变量 Y
591	    code_x: str  # 自变量 X
592	    start_date: str = ""
593	    end_date: str = ""
594	    use_returns: bool = False  # False=收盘价回归，True=日收益率回归
595	    period: str = "1d"
596	
597	
598	@router.post("/regression")
599	async def regression_analysis(body: RegressionRequest):
600	    """两标的线性回归：Y = beta*X + alpha，返回散点/拟合线/统计量/边缘分布"""
601	    sy = _load_close(body.code_y, body.period)
602	    sx = _load_close(body.code_x, body.period)
603	    if sy is None:
604	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_y} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
605	    if sx is None:
606	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_x} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
607	
608	    sy = _clip_range(sy, body.start_date, body.end_date)
609	    sx = _clip_range(sx, body.start_date, body.end_date)
610	    df = pd.DataFrame({"y": sy, "x": sx}).dropna()
611	    if body.use_returns:
612	        df = df.pct_change().dropna()
613	    if len(df) < 10:
614	        return {
615	            "error": "重叠区间样本不足 10 个交易日，无法回归（检查日期区间与数据覆盖）"
616	        }
617	
618	    x, y = df["x"].to_numpy(), df["y"].to_numpy()
619	    beta, alpha = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
620	    r = float(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1])
621	    y_hat = beta * x + alpha
622	    ss_res = float(((y - y_hat) ** 2).sum())
623	    ss_tot = float(((y - y.mean()) ** 2).sum())
624	    r2 = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot if ss_tot > 0 else 0.0
625	
626	    return {
627	        "code_y": body.code_y,
628	        "code_x": body.code_x,
629	        "use_returns": body.use_returns,
630	        "points": [
631	            [round(float(a), 6), round(float(b), 6), str(d.date())]
632	            for d, a, b in zip(df.index, x, y)
633	        ],
634	        "line": {
635	            "x0": float(x.min()),
636	            "y0": float(beta * x.min() + alpha),
637	            "x1": float(x.max()),
638	            "y1": float(beta * x.max() + alpha),
639	        },
640	        "stats": {
641	            "样本数量": len(df),
642	            "Beta": round(float(beta), 4),
643	            "Alpha": round(float(alpha), 4),
644	            "R": round(r, 4),
645	            "R^2": round(float(r2), 4),
646	        },
647	        "hist_x": _histogram(df["x"]),
648	        "hist_y": _histogram(df["y"]),
649	    }
650

652	# ── 季节性分析 ────────────────────────────────────────────────
653	
654	
655	class SeasonalityRequest(BaseModel):
656	    code: str
657	    years: int = 5
658	    period: str = "1d"
659	
660	
661	@router.post("/seasonality")
662	async def seasonality_analysis(body: SeasonalityRequest):
663	    """季节性分析：分年度叠加走势（归一化）+ 月度涨跌幅矩阵 + 逐月统计"""
664	    s = _load_close(body.code, body.period)
665	    if s is None:
666	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
667	
668	    years = sorted(s.index.year.unique())[-max(int(body.years), 2) :]
669	    s = s[s.index.year >= years[0]]
670	    if len(years) < 2:
671	        return {"error": "本地数据不足两个年度，无法做季节性对比"}
672	
673	    # 年度叠加曲线：每年首日归一化为 100，x 轴用 MM-DD
674	    yearly_series = []
675	    for yr in years:
676	        ys = s[s.index.year == yr]
677	        if len(ys) < 20:
678	            continue
679	        norm = ys / float(ys.iloc[0]) * 100.0
680	        yearly_series.append(
681	            {
682	                "year": int(yr),
683	                "x": [d.strftime("%m-%d") for d in norm.index],
684	                "y": [round(float(v), 3) for v in norm.to_numpy()],
685	            }
686	        )
687	
688	    # 月度收益矩阵（月末/月初收盘价环比）
689	    monthly = s.resample("ME").last().pct_change() * 100.0
690	    matrix_rows = []
691	    for yr in years:
692	        row: dict = {"year": int(yr)}
693	        for m in range(1, 13):
694	            sel = monthly[(monthly.index.year == yr) & (monthly.index.month == m)]
695	            row[f"m{m}"] = (
696	                round(float(sel.iloc[0]), 2)
697	                if len(sel) and not pd.isna(sel.iloc[0])
698	                else None
699	            )
700	        matrix_rows.append(row)
701	
702	    # 逐月统计：均值/上涨次数/下跌次数
703	    month_stats = []
704	    for m in range(1, 13):
705	        vals = [r[f"m{m}"] for r in matrix_rows if r[f"m{m}"] is not None]
706	        month_stats.append(
707	            {
708	                "month": m,
709	                "avg": round(float(np.mean(vals)), 2) if vals else None,
710	                "up": sum(1 for v in vals if v > 0),
711	                "down": sum(1 for v in vals if v <= 0),
712	                "count": len(vals),
713	            }
714	        )
715	
716	    return {
717	        "code": body.code,
718	        "years": [int(y) for y in years],
719	        "yearly_series": yearly_series,
720	        "monthly_matrix": matrix_rows,
721	        "month_stats": month_stats,
722	    }
723

725	# ── 历史波动率分析 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
726	
727	
728	class VolatilityRequest(BaseModel):
729	    code: str
730	    windows: list[int] = [5, 15, 30, 50]
731	    annualize: int = 250
732	    start_date: str = ""
733	    end_date: str = ""
734	    period: str = "1d"
735	
736	
737	@router.post("/volatility")
738	async def volatility_analysis(body: VolatilityRequest):
739	    """历史波动率 HV：对数收益滚动标准差年化，多窗口时序 + 统计概览 + 频率分布"""
740	    s = _load_close(body.code, body.period)
741	    if s is None:
742	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
743	
744	    log_ret = np.log(s / s.shift(1))
745	    windows = [max(int(w), 2) for w in (body.windows or [5, 15, 30, 50])][:6]
746	    ann = np.sqrt(max(int(body.annualize), 1))
747	
748	    series_out = []
749	    stats_out = {}
750	    hist_out = {}
751	    for w in windows:
752	        hv = (log_ret.rolling(w).std() * ann).dropna()
753	        hv_clip = _clip_range(hv, body.start_date, body.end_date)
754	        if hv_clip.empty:
755	            continue
756	        name = f"HV{w}"
757	        series_out.append(
758	            {
759	                "name": name,
760	                "x": [str(d.date()) for d in hv_clip.index],
761	                "y": [round(float(v), 4) for v in hv_clip.to_numpy()],
762	            }
763	        )
764	        latest = float(hv_clip.iloc[-1])
765	        stats_out[name] = {
766	            "最新": round(latest, 4),
767	            "均值": round(float(hv_clip.mean()), 4),
768	            "中值": round(float(hv_clip.median()), 4),
769	            "标准差": round(float(hv_clip.std()), 4),
770	            "百分位": round(float((hv_clip < latest).mean() * 100), 2),
771	            "最高": round(float(hv_clip.max()), 4),
772	            "最低": round(float(hv_clip.min()), 4),
773	        }
774	        hist_out[name] = _histogram(hv_clip, bins=12)
775	
776	    if not series_out:
777	        return {"error": "所选区间内数据不足，无法计算波动率（调整区间或窗口）"}
778	
779	    return {
780	        "code": body.code,
781	        "annualize": int(body.annualize),
782	        "series": series_out,
783	        "stats": stats_out,
784	        "histograms": hist_out,
785	    }

791	class CorrelationMatrixRequest(BaseModel):
792	    codes: list[str]
793	    start_date: str = ""
794	    end_date: str = ""
795	    period: str = "1d"
796	
797	
798	@router.post("/correlation")
799	async def correlation_matrix(body: CorrelationMatrixRequest):
800	    """多标的日收益率 Pearson 相关系数矩阵"""
801	    codes = [c.strip() for c in body.codes if c.strip()]
802	    if len(codes) < 2:
803	        return {"error": "至少需要 2 个标的代码"}
804	
805	    frames: dict[str, pd.Series] = {}
806	    missing: list[str] = []
807	    for code in codes[:30]:
808	        s = _load_close(code, body.period)
809	        if s is None:
810	            missing.append(code)
811	            continue
812	        frames[code] = _clip_range(s, body.start_date, body.end_date)
813	
814	    if len(frames) < 2:
815	        return {
816	            "error": "可用标的不足 2 个（缺失: "
817	            + ", ".join(missing[:10])
818	            + "），请先到「数据中心」下载"
819	        }
820	
821	    rets = pd.DataFrame(frames).pct_change().dropna(how="all")
822	    corr = rets.corr(min_periods=10)
823	    ordered = list(corr.columns)
824	    matrix = [
825	        [
826	            None if pd.isna(corr.iloc[i, j]) else round(float(corr.iloc[i, j]), 3)
827	            for j in range(len(ordered))
828	        ]
829	        for i in range(len(ordered))
830	    ]
831	
832	    return {
833	        "codes": ordered,
834	        "matrix": matrix,
835	        "missing": missing,
836	        "n_obs": len(rets),
837	    }

840	# ── 风险画像 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
841	
842	
843	class RiskProfileRequest(BaseModel):
844	    code: str
845	    start_date: str = ""
846	    end_date: str = ""
847	    period: str = "1d"
848	
849	
850	@router.post("/risk-profile")
851	async def risk_profile(body: RiskProfileRequest):
852	    """单标的风险画像：收益/波动/回撤/尾部风险指标 + 净值与回撤曲线 + 收益分布"""
853	    s = _load_close(body.code, body.period)
854	    if s is None:
855	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
856	    s = _clip_range(s, body.start_date, body.end_date)
857	    if len(s) < 30:
858	        return {"error": "区间内样本不足 30 个交易日，无法给出有意义的风险指标"}
859	
860	    ret = s.pct_change().dropna()
861	    equity = (1 + ret).cumprod()
862	    roll_max = equity.cummax()
863	    drawdown = equity / roll_max - 1
864	
865	    n = len(ret)
866	    ann_ret = float((1 + ret.mean()) ** 250 - 1)
867	    ann_vol = float(ret.std() * np.sqrt(250))
868	    sharpe = ann_ret / ann_vol if ann_vol > 0 else 0.0
869	    max_dd = float(drawdown.min())
870	    var95 = float(ret.quantile(0.05))
871	    cvar95 = float(ret[ret <= var95].mean()) if (ret <= var95).any() else var95
872	
873	    metrics = {
874	        "区间涨跌幅": round(float(equity.iloc[-1] - 1) * 100, 2),
875	        "年化收益(%)": round(ann_ret * 100, 2),
876	        "年化波动(%)": round(ann_vol * 100, 2),
877	        "夏普比率": round(sharpe, 3),
878	        "最大回撤(%)": round(max_dd * 100, 2),
879	        "卡玛比率": round(ann_ret / abs(max_dd), 3) if max_dd < 0 else None,
880	        "日胜率(%)": round(float((ret > 0).mean()) * 100, 2),
881	        "偏度": round(float(ret.skew()), 3),
882	        "峰度": round(float(ret.kurt()), 3),
883	        "VaR95(日,%)": round(var95 * 100, 2),
884	        "CVaR95(日,%)": round(cvar95 * 100, 2),
885	        "样本数": n,
886	    }
887	
888	    dates = [str(d.date()) for d in equity.index]
889	    return {
890	        "code": body.code,
891	        "metrics": metrics,
892	        "equity": {"x": dates, "y": [round(float(v), 4) for v in equity]},
893	        "drawdown": {
894	            "x": dates,
895	            "y": [round(float(v) * 100, 2) for v in drawdown],
896	        },
897	        "return_hist": _histogram(ret * 100, bins=30),
898	    }

904	class PairSpreadRequest(BaseModel):
905	    code_a: str
906	    code_b: str
907	    window: int = 60
908	    start_date: str = ""
909	    end_date: str = ""
910	    period: str = "1d"

912	
913	@router.post("/pair-spread")
914	async def pair_spread(body: PairSpreadRequest):
915	    """配对价差：价格比价序列 + 对数价差滚动 Z-Score（±2 带），支持配对交易研究"""
916	    sa = _load_close(body.code_a, body.period)
917	    sb = _load_close(body.code_b, body.period)
918	    if sa is None:
919	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_a} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
920	    if sb is None:
921	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_b} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
922	
923	    df = pd.DataFrame({"a": sa, "b": sb}).dropna()
924	    df = df[(df["a"] > 0) & (df["b"] > 0)]
925	    window = max(int(body.window), 5)
926	    df = _clip_df_range(df, body.start_date, body.end_date, extra_head=window)
927	    if len(df) < window + 10:
928	        return {
929	            "error": f"重叠样本不足（需至少 {window + 10} 个交易日），调整区间或窗口"
930	        }
931	
932	    ratio = df["a"] / df["b"]
933	    log_spread = np.log(df["a"]) - np.log(df["b"])
934	    roll_mean = log_spread.rolling(window).mean()
935	    roll_std = log_spread.rolling(window).std()
936	    zscore = ((log_spread - roll_mean) / roll_std).dropna()
937	
938	    # 裁到用户请求区间（前面多取了 window 个热身样本）
939	    if body.start_date:
940	        zscore = zscore[zscore.index >= pd.to_datetime(body.start_date)]
941	        ratio = ratio[ratio.index >= pd.to_datetime(body.start_date)]
942	    if zscore.empty:
943	        return {"error": "所选区间内无有效 Z-Score 样本，请扩大区间"}
944	
945	    ret_corr = float(df["a"].pct_change().corr(df["b"].pct_change()))
946	    cur_z = float(zscore.iloc[-1])
947	    return {
948	        "code_a": body.code_a,
949	        "code_b": body.code_b,
950	        "window": window,
951	        "stats": {
952	            "当前 Z-Score": round(cur_z, 3),
953	            "收益相关系数": round(ret_corr, 3),
954	            "当前比价": round(float(ratio.iloc[-1]), 4),
955	            "比价均值": round(float(ratio.mean()), 4),
956	            "|Z|>2 占比(%)": round(float((zscore.abs() > 2).mean()) * 100, 2),
957	            "样本数": len(zscore),
958	        },
959	        "ratio": {
960	            "x": [str(d.date()) for d in ratio.index],
961	            "y": [round(float(v), 4) for v in ratio],
962	        },
963	        "zscore": {
964	            "x": [str(d.date()) for d in zscore.index],
965	            "y": [round(float(v), 3) for v in zscore],
966	        },
967	    }
968

970	def _clip_df_range(
971	    df: pd.DataFrame, start_date: str, end_date: str, extra_head: int = 0
972	) -> pd.DataFrame:
973	    """按区间裁剪 DataFrame，可在起点前多保留 extra_head 行供滚动窗口热身"""
974	    if end_date:
975	        df = df[df.index <= pd.to_datetime(end_date)]
976	    if start_date:
977	        start = pd.to_datetime(start_date)
978	        pos = df.index.searchsorted(start)
979	        df = df.iloc[max(0, int(pos) - extra_head) :]
980	    return df

995	@router.post("/rolling-corr")
996	async def rolling_corr(body: RollingCorrRequest):
997	    """两标的日收益的滚动相关系数与滚动 Beta（a 对 b 回归）时序"""
998	    sa = _load_close(body.code_a, body.period)
999	    sb = _load_close(body.code_b, body.period)
1000	    if sa is None:
1001	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_a} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
1002	    if sb is None:
1003	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_b} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
1004	
1005	    rets = pd.DataFrame({"a": sa, "b": sb}).dropna().pct_change().dropna()
1006	    window = max(int(body.window), 10)
1007	    rets = _clip_df_range(rets, body.start_date, body.end_date, extra_head=window)
1008	    if len(rets) < window + 5:
1009	        return {
1010	            "error": f"重叠样本不足（需至少 {window + 5} 个交易日），调整区间或窗口"
1011	        }
1012	
1013	    roll_corr = rets["a"].rolling(window).corr(rets["b"])
1014	    roll_beta = (
1015	        rets["a"].rolling(window).cov(rets["b"]) / rets["b"].rolling(window).var()
1016	    )
1017	    out = pd.DataFrame({"corr": roll_corr, "beta": roll_beta}).dropna()
1018	    if body.start_date:
1019	        out = out[out.index >= pd.to_datetime(body.start_date)]
1020	    if out.empty:
1021	        return {"error": "所选区间内无有效滚动样本，请扩大区间"}
1022	
1023	    return {
1024	        "code_a": body.code_a,
1025	        "code_b": body.code_b,
1026	        "window": window,
1027	        "stats": {
1028	            "当前相关": round(float(out["corr"].iloc[-1]), 3),
1029	            "相关均值": round(float(out["corr"].mean()), 3),
1030	            "当前 Beta": round(float(out["beta"].iloc[-1]), 3),
1031	            "Beta 均值": round(float(out["beta"].mean()), 3),
1032	            "样本数": len(out),
1033	        },
1034	        "x": [str(d.date()) for d in out.index],
1035	        "corr": [round(float(v), 3) for v in out["corr"]],
1036	        "beta": [round(float(v), 3) for v in out["beta"]],
1037	    }

2	from __future__ import annotations

13	# 单次查询返回的最大结果行数（防止整市场扫描 OOM）
14	MAX_RESULT_ROWS = 2000
15	
16	# 写/危险操作关键字，禁止在本地查询接口中出现（读接口只允许查询）
17	_SQL_FORBIDDEN = re.compile(
18	    r"\b(insert|update|delete|drop|create|alter|attach|detach|"
19	    r"export|copy|import|install|load|pragma|call)\b",
20	    re.IGNORECASE,

24	class DuckDBService:
25	    """DuckDB 查询服务，提供对本地 Parquet 缓存的 SQL 访问"""
26	
27	    def __init__(self):
28	        self.cache_dir = settings.cache_dir
29	
30	    # ── 核心查询 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
31	
32	    def query_local(self, sql: str, params: list | None = None) -> dict:
33	        """执行 SQL 查询本地 Parquet 数据
34	
35	        支持语法：
36	            SELECT * FROM read_parquet('data/cache/1d/*.parquet') WHERE ...
37	            SELECT * FROM 'data/cache/1d/000001_SZ.parquet' WHERE ...
38	
39	        Args:
40	            sql: SQL 查询语句
41	            params: 查询参数
42	
43	        Returns:
44	            {"columns": [...], "data": [...], "row_count": N}
45	        """
46	        try:
47	            statement = sql.lstrip().lstrip("(").lower()
48	            if not statement.startswith(("select", "with", "describe", "show")):
49	                return {
50	                    "columns": [],
51	                    "data": [],
52	                    "row_count": 0,
53	                    "error": "仅支持 SELECT / WITH / DESCRIBE 查询",
54	                }
55	            if _SQL_FORBIDDEN.search(sql):
56	                return {
57	                    "columns": [],
58	                    "data": [],
59	                    "row_count": 0,
60	                    "error": "SQL 中包含不允许的写操作关键字",
61	                }
62	
63	            conn = duckdb.connect()
64	            if params:
65	                result = conn.execute(sql, params).fetchdf()
66	            else:
67	                result = conn.execute(sql).fetchdf()
68	            conn.close()
69	
70	            truncated = len(result) > MAX_RESULT_ROWS
71	            if truncated:
72	                result = result.iloc[:MAX_RESULT_ROWS]
73	
74	            columns = result.columns.tolist()
75	            data = result.values.tolist()
76	
77	            # 清理 NaN / Timestamp 等不可序列化类型
78	            clean_data = []
79	            for row in data:
80	                clean_row = []
81	                for val in row:
82	                    if isinstance(val, float) and math.isnan(val):
83	                        clean_row.append(None)
84	                    elif isinstance(val, pd.Timestamp):
85	                        clean_row.append(str(val))
86	                    else:
87	                        clean_row.append(val)
88	                clean_data.append(clean_row)
89	
90	            return {
91	                "columns": columns,
92	                "data": clean_data,
93	                "row_count": len(clean_data),
94	                "truncated": truncated if truncated else False,
95	            }
96	        except Exception as e:
97	            logger.error(f"DuckDB query failed: {e}")
98	            return {"columns": [], "data": [], "row_count": 0, "error": str(e)}
99	
100	    # ── 路径工具 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
101	
102	    def get_parquet_path(self, code: str, period: str = "1d") -> str:
103	        """获取 Parquet 文件路径字符串（可直接用于 SQL）
104	
105	        Args:
106	            code: 股票代码（如 "000001.SZ"，内部将 '.' 替换为 '_'）
107	            period: 数据周期
108	
109	        Returns:
110	            绝对路径字符串
111	        """
112	        safe_code = code.replace(".", "_")
113	        return str(self.cache_dir / period / f"{safe_code}.parquet")

33	def _cache_files(period: str = "1d") -> list[Path]:
34	    d = settings.cache_dir / period
35	    if not d.exists():
36	        return []
37	    return sorted(d.glob("*.parquet"))

40	def _file_code(path: Path) -> str:
41	    """000001_SZ.parquet → 000001.SZ"""
42	    return path.stem.replace("_", ".")

45	def _load_stock(path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
46	    try:
47	        df = pd.read_parquet(path)
48	        df.index = pd.to_datetime(df.index)
49	        return df
50	    except Exception:
51	        return None

54	def _clean_value(val):
55	    if isinstance(val, float) and (math.isnan(val) or math.isinf(val)):
56	        return None
57	    if isinstance(val, (pd.Timestamp,)):
58	        return str(val)
59	    if isinstance(val, (np.integer,)):
60	        return int(val)
61	    if isinstance(val, (np.floating,)):
62	        return float(val)
63	    return val

78	async def _record_sql(sql: str, name: str = "") -> None:
79	    """记录 SQL 历史（最近 200 条以内按 last_used_at 去重覆盖）"""
80	    cleaned = sql.strip().rstrip(";").strip()
81	    if not cleaned:
82	        return
83	    now = int(time.time())
84	    db = await get_db()
85	    try:
86	        cursor = await db.execute(
87	            "SELECT id, last_used_at FROM research_sql_queries WHERE sql = ?",
88	            (cleaned,),
89	        )
90	        row = await cursor.fetchone()
91	        if row:
92	            await db.execute(
93	                "UPDATE research_sql_queries SET last_used_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
94	                (now, row["id"]),
95	            )
96	        else:
97	            await db.execute(
98	                "INSERT INTO research_sql_queries (name, sql, created_at, last_used_at) "
99	                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
100	                (name or "未命名查询", cleaned, now, now),
101	            )
102	        await db.commit()
103	    finally:
104	        await db.close()

107	@router.post("/query")
108	async def sql_query(body: SQLQueryRequest):
109	    """DuckDB SQL 查询本地 Parquet 数据（仅允许 SELECT）"""
110	    sql = body.sql.strip().rstrip(";")
111	    if not sql:
112	        return {
113	            "columns": [],
114	            "data": [],
115	            "row_count": 0,
116	            "error": "SQL 为空",
117	            "code": "invalid_query",
118	        }
119	    if not sql.lower().lstrip("(").startswith(("select", "with", "describe", "show")):
120	        return {
121	            "columns": [],
122	            "data": [],
123	            "row_count": 0,
124	            "error": "仅支持 SELECT / WITH / DESCRIBE 查询",
125	            "code": "invalid_query",
126	        }
127	    if _SQL_FORBIDDEN.search(sql):
128	        return {
129	            "columns": [],
130	            "data": [],
131	            "row_count": 0,
132	            "error": "SQL 中包含不允许的写操作关键字",
133	            "code": "invalid_query",
134	        }
135	    result = duckdb_service.query_local(sql)
136	    if isinstance(result, dict) and result.get("error"):
137	        result.setdefault("code", "query_error")
138	        return result
139	    await _record_sql(sql)
140	    return result

259	@router.get("/tables")
260	async def list_tables():
261	    """列出本地可查询的数据表（各周期的 Parquet 缓存）
262	
263	    sample_range 取该周期全部文件的并集范围，而不是第一个文件的范围；
264	    避免 QUBE get_data_status 拿到单文件样本区间后误判可回测区间。
265	    """
266	    tables = []
267	    cache_dir = settings.cache_dir
268	    if cache_dir.exists():
269	        for period_dir in sorted(cache_dir.iterdir()):
270	            if not period_dir.is_dir():
271	                continue
272	            files = sorted(period_dir.glob("*.parquet"))
273	            if not files:
274	                continue
275	
276	            if period_dir.name == "reference":
277	                # 参考快照是 [date, code, ...] 长表，不是行情面板；
278	                # 日期范围来自 date 列，而不是把默认 RangeIndex 误解析成 1970。
279	                columns: list[str] = []
280	                ref_dates: list = []
281	                for f in files:
282	                    try:
283	                        df = pd.read_parquet(f)
284	                        columns = list(df.columns)
285	                        if "date" in df.columns:
286	                            ref_dates.extend(pd.to_datetime(df["date"], errors="coerce").dropna().tolist())
287	                    except Exception:
288	                        continue
289	                date_range = (
290	                    f"{min(ref_dates).date()} ~ {max(ref_dates).date()}"
291	                    if ref_dates
292	                    else ""
293	                )
294	                tables.append(
295	                    {
296	                        "period": "reference",
297	                        "path": "data/cache/reference/*.parquet",
298	                        "kind": "reference",
299	                        "file_count": len(files),
300	                        "columns": columns,
301	                        "sample_range": date_range,
302	                        "codes": [],
303	                        "note": "参考元数据快照（行业/成分/合约/两融池），非行情价格表",
304	                    }
305	                )
306	                continue
307	
308	            # 行情周期：用覆盖度缓存的并集范围；列结构只读第一个文件即可（下载层保证同构）
309	            sample = _load_stock(files[0])
310	            columns = list(sample.columns) if sample is not None else []
311	            date_range = ""
312	            try:
313	                coverage = market_data.cache_coverage(period_dir.name)
314	                starts = [e.get("start") for e in coverage if e.get("start")]
315	                ends = [e.get("end") for e in coverage if e.get("end")]
316	                if starts and ends:
317	                    date_range = f"{min(starts)} ~ {max(ends)}"
318	            except Exception:
319	                if sample is not None and len(sample) > 0:
320	                    date_range = f"{sample.index.min().date()} ~ {sample.index.max().date()}"
321	            all_codes = [_file_code(f) for f in files]
322	            tables.append(
323	                {
324	                    "period": period_dir.name,
325	                    "path": f"data/cache/{period_dir.name}/*.parquet",
326	                    "kind": "quotes",
327	                    "stock_count": len(files),
328	                    "columns": columns,
329	                    "sample_range": date_range,
330	                    "codes": all_codes[:200],
331	                    "codes_truncated": len(all_codes) > 200,
332	                    "note": (
333	                        "缓存为不复权价 + adjust_factor 列；前复权价 = close × adjust_factor / 最新 adjust_factor"
334	                        if "adjust_factor" in columns
335	                        else "旧版前复权缓存（无 adjust_factor 列）"
336	                    ),
337	                }
338	            )
339	    return {"tables": tables}

344	_COND_RE = re.compile(
345	    r"^\s*([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\s*(>=|<=|>|<|==|!=|=)\s*(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*$"
346	)
347

349	class ScanRequest(BaseModel):
350	    date: str
351	    conditions: list[str] = []
352	    period: str = "1d"
353	
354	
355	@router.post("/scan")
356	async def market_scan(body: ScanRequest):
357	    """按日期对全部缓存股票做条件扫描（如 close > 10; volume > 1000000）"""
358	    files = _cache_files(body.period)
359	    if not files:
360	        err = market_data.no_cache_error_detail(body.period)
361	        return {
362	            "columns": [],
363	            "data": [],
364	            "row_count": 0,
365	            "error": err["message"] + " — " + err["hint"],
366	            "code": err["code"],
367	        }
368	
369	    parsed = []
370	    for cond in body.conditions:
371	        m = _COND_RE.match(cond)
372	        if not m:
373	            return {
374	                "columns": [],
375	                "data": [],
376	                "row_count": 0,
377	                "error": f"条件格式不支持: {cond}（示例: close > 10）",
378	                "code": "invalid_request",
379	            }
380	        col, op, val = m.group(1), m.group(2), float(m.group(3))
381	        parsed.append((col, "==" if op == "=" else op, val))
382	
383	    try:
384	        target = pd.to_datetime(body.date)
385	    except Exception:
386	        return {
387	            "columns": [],
388	            "data": [],
389	            "row_count": 0,
390	            "error": "日期格式不合法",
391	            "code": "invalid_request",
392	        }
393	
394	    rows = []
395	    columns: list[str] = []
396	    for path in files:
397	        df = _load_stock(path)
398	        if df is None or df.empty:
399	            continue
400	        day = df[df.index.normalize() == target.normalize()]
401	        if day.empty:
402	            continue
403	        rec = day.iloc[-1]
404	        ok = True
405	        for col, op, val in parsed:
406	            if col not in rec.index:
407	                ok = False
408	                break
409	            v = rec[col]
410	            if pd.isna(v):
411	                ok = False
412	                break
413	            if (
414	                (op == ">" and v <= val)
415	                or (op == "<" and v >= val)
416	                or (op == ">=" and v < val)
417	                or (op == "<=" and v > val)
418	                or (op == "==" and v != val)
419	                or (op == "!=" and v == val)
420	            ):
421	                ok = False
422	            if not ok:
423	                break
424	        if ok:
425	            if not columns:
426	                columns = ["code"] + list(rec.index)
427	            rows.append([_file_code(path)] + [_clean_value(v) for v in rec.tolist()])
428	
429	    return {"columns": columns, "data": rows, "row_count": len(rows)}
430

435	class CrossSectionRequest(BaseModel):

441	@router.post("/cross-section")
442	async def cross_section(body: CrossSectionRequest):
443	    """某日全市场指定字段的截面统计与分布直方图"""
444	    files = _cache_files(body.period)
445	    if not files:
446	        err = market_data.no_cache_error_detail(body.period)
447	        return {
448	            "error": err["message"] + " — " + err["hint"],
449	            "code": err["code"],
450	        }
451	
452	    try:
453	        target = pd.to_datetime(body.date)
454	    except Exception:
455	        return {"error": "日期格式不合法", "code": "invalid_request"}
456	
457	    values = []
458	    for path in files:
459	        df = _load_stock(path)
460	        if df is None or df.empty or body.field not in df.columns:
461	            continue
462	        day = df[df.index.normalize() == target.normalize()]
463	        if day.empty:
464	            continue
465	        v = day.iloc[-1][body.field]
466	        if not pd.isna(v):
467	            values.append(float(v))
468	
469	    if not values:
470	        return {
471	            "error": f"该日期无 {body.field} 数据（检查日期是否为交易日、数据是否已缓存）",
472	            "code": "no_data",
473	        }
474	
475	    s = pd.Series(values)
476	    stats_cols = ["count", "mean", "median", "stddev", "min", "max", "q25", "q75"]
477	    stats_row = [
478	        int(s.count()),
479	        float(s.mean()),
480	        float(s.median()),
481	        float(s.std()) if len(s) > 1 else 0.0,
482	        float(s.min()),
483	        float(s.max()),
484	        float(s.quantile(0.25)),
485	        float(s.quantile(0.75)),
486	    ]
487	
488	    # 直方图（20 个分箱）
489	    counts, edges = np.histogram(s, bins=20)
490	    histogram = [
491	        {"bin": f"{edges[i]:.2f}", "count": int(counts[i])} for i in range(len(counts))
492	    ]
493	
494	    return {
495	        "statistics": {"columns": stats_cols, "data": [stats_row], "row_count": 1},
496	        "histogram": histogram,
497	    }

502	
503	class AnomalyRequest(BaseModel):
504	    code: str
505	    field: str = "close"
506	    window: int = 20
507	    threshold: float = 2.0
508	    period: str = "1d"
509	
510	
511	@router.post("/anomaly")
512	async def anomaly_detection(body: AnomalyRequest):
513	    """滚动 Z-Score 异常检测：|值 - 滚动均值| > threshold × 滚动标准差"""
514	    safe_code = body.code.strip().replace(".", "_")
515	    path = settings.cache_dir / body.period / f"{safe_code}.parquet"
516	    if not path.exists():
517	        return {
518	            "error": f"未找到 {body.code} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载",
519	            "code": "no_cached_data",
520	        }
521	
522	    df = _load_stock(path)
523	    if df is None or df.empty or body.field not in df.columns:
524	        return {"error": f"数据为空或缺少字段 {body.field}", "code": "invalid_field"}
525	
526	    s = df[body.field].astype(float)
527	    window = max(int(body.window), 2)
528	    rolling_mean = s.rolling(window).mean()
529	    rolling_std = s.rolling(window).std()
530	    zscore = (s - rolling_mean) / rolling_std
531	    mask = zscore.abs() > body.threshold
532	
533	    columns = ["date", body.field, "rolling_mean", "zscore", "direction"]
534	    rows = []
535	    for idx in s.index[mask.fillna(False)]:
536	        z = float(zscore.loc[idx])
537	        rows.append(
538	            [
539	                str(idx.date()),
540	                _clean_value(s.loc[idx]),
541	                _clean_value(rolling_mean.loc[idx]),
542	                round(z, 3),
543	                "偏高" if z > 0 else "偏低",
544	            ]
545	        )
546	
547	    return {
548	        "anomalies": {"columns": columns, "data": rows, "row_count": len(rows)},
549	        "code": body.code,
550	        "field": body.field,
551	    }

557	def _load_close(code: str, period: str = "1d") -> pd.Series | None:
558	    """加载单只股票的收盘价序列（本地缓存），不存在返回 None"""
559	    safe_code = code.strip().replace(".", "_")
560	    path = settings.cache_dir / period / f"{safe_code}.parquet"
561	    if not path.exists():
562	        return None
563	    df = _load_stock(path)
564	    if df is None or df.empty or "close" not in df.columns:
565	        return None
566	    s = df["close"].astype(float).dropna()
567	    s.index = pd.to_datetime(s.index).normalize()
568	    return s[~s.index.duplicated(keep="last")].sort_index()
569	
570	
571	def _clip_range(s: pd.Series, start_date: str, end_date: str) -> pd.Series:
572	    if start_date:
573	        s = s[s.index >= pd.to_datetime(start_date)]
574	    if end_date:
575	        s = s[s.index <= pd.to_datetime(end_date)]
576	    return s
577	
578	
579	def _histogram(values: pd.Series, bins: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
580	    counts, edges = np.histogram(values.dropna(), bins=bins)
581	    return [
582	        {"bin": f"{edges[i]:.4g}", "count": int(counts[i])} for i in range(len(counts))
583	    ]

592	    start_date: str = ""
593	    end_date: str = ""
594	    use_returns: bool = False  # False=收盘价回归，True=日收益率回归
595	    period: str = "1d"
596	
597	
598	@router.post("/regression")
599	async def regression_analysis(body: RegressionRequest):
600	    """两标的线性回归：Y = beta*X + alpha，返回散点/拟合线/统计量/边缘分布"""
601	    sy = _load_close(body.code_y, body.period)
602	    sx = _load_close(body.code_x, body.period)
603	    if sy is None:
604	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_y} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
605	    if sx is None:
606	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code_x} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
607	
608	    sy = _clip_range(sy, body.start_date, body.end_date)
609	    sx = _clip_range(sx, body.start_date, body.end_date)
610	    df = pd.DataFrame({"y": sy, "x": sx}).dropna()
611	    if body.use_returns:
612	        df = df.pct_change().dropna()
613	    if len(df) < 10:
614	        return {
615	            "error": "重叠区间样本不足 10 个交易日，无法回归（检查日期区间与数据覆盖）"
616	        }
617	
618	    x, y = df["x"].to_numpy(), df["y"].to_numpy()
619	    beta, alpha = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
620	    r = float(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1])
621	    y_hat = beta * x + alpha
622	    ss_res = float(((y - y_hat) ** 2).sum())
623	    ss_tot = float(((y - y.mean()) ** 2).sum())
624	    r2 = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot if ss_tot > 0 else 0.0
625	
626	    return {
627	        "code_y": body.code_y,
628	        "code_x": body.code_x,
629	        "use_returns": body.use_returns,
630	        "points": [
631	            [round(float(a), 6), round(float(b), 6), str(d.date())]
632	            for d, a, b in zip(df.index, x, y)
633	        ],
634	        "line": {
635	            "x0": float(x.min()),
636	            "y0": float(beta * x.min() + alpha),
637	            "x1": float(x.max()),
638	            "y1": float(beta * x.max() + alpha),
639	        },
640	        "stats": {
641	            "样本数量": len(df),
642	            "Beta": round(float(beta), 4),
643	            "Alpha": round(float(alpha), 4),
644	            "R": round(r, 4),
645	            "R^2": round(float(r2), 4),
646	        },
647	        "hist_x": _histogram(df["x"]),
648	        "hist_y": _histogram(df["y"]),
649	    }

655	class SeasonalityRequest(BaseModel):
656	    code: str
657	    years: int = 5

661	@router.post("/seasonality")
662	async def seasonality_analysis(body: SeasonalityRequest):
663	    """季节性分析：分年度叠加走势（归一化）+ 月度涨跌幅矩阵 + 逐月统计"""
664	    s = _load_close(body.code, body.period)
665	    if s is None:
666	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
667	
668	    years = sorted(s.index.year.unique())[-max(int(body.years), 2) :]
669	    s = s[s.index.year >= years[0]]
670	    if len(years) < 2:
671	        return {"error": "本地数据不足两个年度，无法做季节性对比"}
672	
673	    # 年度叠加曲线：每年首日归一化为 100，x 轴用 MM-DD
674	    yearly_series = []
675	    for yr in years:
676	        ys = s[s.index.year == yr]
677	        if len(ys) < 20:
678	            continue
679	        norm = ys / float(ys.iloc[0]) * 100.0
680	        yearly_series.append(
681	            {
682	                "year": int(yr),
683	                "x": [d.strftime("%m-%d") for d in norm.index],
684	                "y": [round(float(v), 3) for v in norm.to_numpy()],
685	            }
686	        )
687	
688	    # 月度收益矩阵（月末/月初收盘价环比）
689	    monthly = s.resample("ME").last().pct_change() * 100.0
690	    matrix_rows = []
691	    for yr in years:
692	        row: dict = {"year": int(yr)}
693	        for m in range(1, 13):
694	            sel = monthly[(monthly.index.year == yr) & (monthly.index.month == m)]
695	            row[f"m{m}"] = (
696	                round(float(sel.iloc[0]), 2)
697	                if len(sel) and not pd.isna(sel.iloc[0])
698	                else None
699	            )
700	        matrix_rows.append(row)
701	
702	    # 逐月统计：均值/上涨次数/下跌次数
703	    month_stats = []
704	    for m in range(1, 13):
705	        vals = [r[f"m{m}"] for r in matrix_rows if r[f"m{m}"] is not None]
706	        month_stats.append(
707	            {
708	                "month": m,
709	                "avg": round(float(np.mean(vals)), 2) if vals else None,
710	                "up": sum(1 for v in vals if v > 0),
711	                "down": sum(1 for v in vals if v <= 0),
712	                "count": len(vals),
713	            }
714	        )
715	
716	    return {
717	        "code": body.code,
718	        "years": [int(y) for y in years],
719	        "yearly_series": yearly_series,
720	        "monthly_matrix": matrix_rows,
721	        "month_stats": month_stats,
722	    }

728	class VolatilityRequest(BaseModel):
729	    code: str
730	    windows: list[int] = [5, 15, 30, 50]
731	    annualize: int = 250
732	    start_date: str = ""
733	    end_date: str = ""
734	    period: str = "1d"

736	
737	@router.post("/volatility")
738	async def volatility_analysis(body: VolatilityRequest):
739	    """历史波动率 HV：对数收益滚动标准差年化，多窗口时序 + 统计概览 + 频率分布"""
740	    s = _load_close(body.code, body.period)
741	    if s is None:
742	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
743	
744	    log_ret = np.log(s / s.shift(1))
745	    windows = [max(int(w), 2) for w in (body.windows or [5, 15, 30, 50])][:6]
746	    ann = np.sqrt(max(int(body.annualize), 1))
747	
748	    series_out = []
749	    stats_out = {}
750	    hist_out = {}
751	    for w in windows:
752	        hv = (log_ret.rolling(w).std() * ann).dropna()
753	        hv_clip = _clip_range(hv, body.start_date, body.end_date)
754	        if hv_clip.empty:
755	            continue
756	        name = f"HV{w}"
757	        series_out.append(
758	            {
759	                "name": name,
760	                "x": [str(d.date()) for d in hv_clip.index],
761	                "y": [round(float(v), 4) for v in hv_clip.to_numpy()],
762	            }
763	        )
764	        latest = float(hv_clip.iloc[-1])
765	        stats_out[name] = {
766	            "最新": round(latest, 4),
767	            "均值": round(float(hv_clip.mean()), 4),
768	            "中值": round(float(hv_clip.median()), 4),
769	            "标准差": round(float(hv_clip.std()), 4),
770	            "百分位": round(float((hv_clip < latest).mean() * 100), 2),
771	            "最高": round(float(hv_clip.max()), 4),
772	            "最低": round(float(hv_clip.min()), 4),
773	        }
774	        hist_out[name] = _histogram(hv_clip, bins=12)
775	
776	    if not series_out:
777	        return {"error": "所选区间内数据不足，无法计算波动率（调整区间或窗口）"}
778	
779	    return {
780	        "code": body.code,
781	        "annualize": int(body.annualize),
782	        "series": series_out,
783	        "stats": stats_out,
784	        "histograms": hist_out,
785	    }

829	        for i in range(len(ordered))

841	
842	
843	class RiskProfileRequest(BaseModel):
844	    code: str
845	    start_date: str = ""
846	    end_date: str = ""
847	    period: str = "1d"
848	
849	
850	@router.post("/risk-profile")
851	async def risk_profile(body: RiskProfileRequest):
852	    """单标的风险画像：收益/波动/回撤/尾部风险指标 + 净值与回撤曲线 + 收益分布"""
853	    s = _load_close(body.code, body.period)
854	    if s is None:
855	        return {"error": f"未找到 {body.code} 的本地缓存数据，请先到「数据中心」下载"}
856	    s = _clip_range(s, body.start_date, body.end_date)
857	    if len(s) < 30:
858	        return {"error": "区间内样本不足 30 个交易日，无法给出有意义的风险指标"}
859	
860	    ret = s.pct_change().dropna()
861	    equity = (1 + ret).cumprod()
862	    roll_max = equity.cummax()
863	    drawdown = equity / roll_max - 1
864	
865	    n = len(ret)
866	    ann_ret = float((1 + ret.mean()) ** 250 - 1)
867	    ann_vol = float(ret.std() * np.sqrt(250))
868	    sharpe = ann_ret / ann_vol if ann_vol > 0 else 0.0
869	    max_dd = float(drawdown.min())
870	    var95 = float(ret.quantile(0.05))
871	    cvar95 = float(ret[ret <= var95].mean()) if (ret <= var95).any() else var95
872	
873	    metrics = {
874	        "区间涨跌幅": round(float(equity.iloc[-1] - 1) * 100, 2),
875	        "年化收益(%)": round(ann_ret * 100, 2),
876	        "年化波动(%)": round(ann_vol * 100, 2),
877	        "夏普比率": round(sharpe, 3),
878	        "最大回撤(%)": round(max_dd * 100, 2),
879	        "卡玛比率": round(ann_ret / abs(max_dd), 3) if max_dd < 0 else None,
880	        "日胜率(%)": round(float((ret > 0).mean()) * 100, 2),
881	        "偏度": round(float(ret.skew()), 3),
882	        "峰度": round(float(ret.kurt()), 3),
883	        "VaR95(日,%)": round(var95 * 100, 2),
884	        "CVaR95(日,%)": round(cvar95 * 100, 2),
885	        "样本数": n,
886	    }
887	
888	    dates = [str(d.date()) for d in equity.index]
889	    return {
890	        "code": body.code,
891	        "metrics": metrics,
892	        "equity": {"x": dates, "y": [round(float(v), 4) for v in equity]},
893	        "drawdown": {
894	            "x": dates,
895	            "y": [round(float(v) * 100, 2) for v in drawdown],
896	        },
897	        "return_hist": _histogram(ret * 100, bins=30),
898	    }
